runners.name: Decade Of Time
runners.spotlight: Won 1m novice events at Windsor (good to firm) and Nottingham (soft); 9-1, good second of six in a valuable race for handicap debut at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) three weeks ago, always close up and racing freely early on; up 2lb but, after just four races, can still do better.
runners.comment: Two novice wins; good second of six in valuable 1m2f race for handicap debut at Newmarket

runners.name: Ciarrai Abu
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden on return and shaped well in a close, running-on fourth on handicap debut next time, both 1m at this track (good); built on that when winning by a nose in 11-runner race at Ascot (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago, when he made up his ground in taking fashion but hung left when challenging; up 6lb but well worth a go at 1m2f and still brings abundant promise.
runners.comment: Proved himself here; won two of three 1m starts as 3yo; worth a go at 1m2f; promising

runners.name: Dial Me In
runners.spotlight: Won the first of his five races and best form on penultimate start (10.5f, good); 1m4f for handicap debut looked interesting at Royal Ascot (good to firm; 28-1) on latest but he was a never-dangerous 13th of 19 after making a move early in straight, suggesting this trip is a better fit after all.
runners.comment: 28-1 at Royal Ascot (1m4f) when never-dangerous 13th after making a move early in straight

runners.name: Strength Of Spirit
runners.spotlight: Three wins from ten races, the latest win in April on reappearance; well beaten here in May but that was 7f and he's done much better when finishing close up from towards rear over 1m1f at Musselburgh on his two outings since; better is needed but 1m2f looks plausible.
runners.comment: Finished close up from towards rear over 1m1f at Musselburgh on his last two outings
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Ltd XXXV & E Burke

runners.name: Birgham Dub
runners.spotlight: Won last July in his only 2yo start and reappeared with a novice win at Southwell (1m4f, AW) in April; kept to 1m4f when he earned his highest ratings in Listed race at Longchamp and handicap at Royal Ascot (good to firm) last two outings, beaten 8l in both but the way he went last time makes 1m2f look worth a go; yard had two winners at the big Ascot meeting last Saturday.
runners.comment: Beaten 8l in handicap at Royal Ascot (1m4f) but the way he went makes 1m2f look worth a go

runners.name: Lion Of Alba
runners.spotlight: 2yo novice winner and an always-prominent fourth of 30 on handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month; not so hot at Newmarket (1m) three weeks ago, which sees a tongue-tie enlisted today; his dam being a 1m4f/1m5f winner heightens interest in this new trip.
runners.comment: Best form when 4th of 30 at Royal Ascot (1m) on penultimate start; new trip is interesting

runners.name: Loz Vegas
runners.spotlight: Solid performances sent handicapping over 1m on his three starts this season, fourth of 11 to Ciarrai Abu at Ascot (good to firm) last time; now 5lb lower than on handicap/seasonal debut, which does not make a compelling case for him but this return to 1m2f is also likely to help.
runners.comment: Fourth to Ciarrai Abu at Ascot (1m, good to firm) last time; return to 1m2f should help

runners.name: Bourbon Blues
runners.spotlight: Third in 1m1f Listed race on reappearance and a rallying sixth of 16 in 1m2f handicap at Royal Ascot; drop back to 1m was probably against him on latest start but he's pretty exposed compared to many of today's rivals.
runners.comment: Drop back to 1m was probably against him on latest start but he's pretty exposed
runners.owner: M Hughes, M Kerr-Dineen And Partners

runners.name: Dark Whisper
runners.spotlight: Contested three 1m maidens on good ground, favourite when coming with a steady run to reel in the front-running Lean d'Aislingean at Ffos Las on latest; this handicap debut is a very different contest, requiring marked improvement, but his dam was a progressive 9.4f-1m4f winner and the best has surely not yet been seen of him.
runners.comment: Three 1m maidens, reeling in Lean d'Aislingean at Ffos Las on latest; dam 9.4f-1m4f winner

runners.name: Savvy Disko
runners.spotlight: Fair form at Newmarket in his two runs last October; edged out a 1-3 favourite in novice at Lingfield (1m, AW) in May and led over 2f out when easily following up in a five-runner handicap on the turf track there (1m1f, good to firm) five weeks ago; up 9lb and into a much more competitive race but it's hard to pin down exactly how good he is.
runners.comment: Up 9lb and into a much more competitive race today but he won easily at Lingfield (1m1f)

runners.name: Harmonics
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden at Southwell (1m, AW) in May and pulverised the opposition in a novice at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) in June; 17-2 for handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) where he raced freely off the pace and was a never-dangerous eighth, tending to hang up the straight, but that was his best form (beaten about only 4l) and he may be more street-wise this time.
runners.comment: Never-dangerous eighth on Royal Ascot handicap debut (1m2f); may now be more street-wise

runners.name: Lean d'Aislingean
runners.spotlight: Set the pace, or ridden up with it, on all three starts; those were over 1m and he was nabbed only late on by Dark Whisper in a maiden at Ffos Las (good; unraced on good to firm) last time; major improvement is needed in this hot race for handicap debut but he's unexposed, with the sire and dam's sire suggesting he will stay.
runners.comment: Nabbed late on by Dark Whisper in a 1m maiden at Ffos Las; unexposed for handicap debut

runners.name: Evanesco
runners.spotlight: Close second here one year ago; bossed a five-runner handicap at Newmarket (1m2f) impressively this May; doing the same wasn't possible at Royal Ascot, where he wasn't at all discredited in seventh, but he was able to dictate at Newmarket three weeks ago, so what he produced to take 5l fifth of six that day wouldn't cut the mustard in today's race.
runners.comment: Excused Royal Ascot; Newmarket performance last time wouldn't cut the mustard in this race

runners.name: Gonna Fly
runners.spotlight: Won novice races at Newbury last October and Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) this June; better form when about 2l fifth of eight on handicap debut at Chester (1m2f, good; 6-1) three weeks ago, close up racing freely early on but keeping on; needs better but could still have potential.
runners.comment: About 2l fifth of eight on handicap debut at Chester (1m2f) but could still have potential

runners.name: Adaay Of Scarlett
runners.spotlight: Improved for the step up to 6f when runner-up at 40-1 in the Coventry at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm) and bumped into an exciting Godolphin winner when second of three in the Group 2 July Stakes at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; there's every chance he'll be in the mix.
runners.comment: Runner-up in Group 2 races on his last two starts and every chance he'll be in the mix

runners.name: Jaan Ki Tukri
runners.spotlight: Placed on first three starts (5f, good/good to firm) before respectable ninth in the Coventry at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm); showed blistering pace when easily making all in first-time cheekpieces in a recent maiden at Ffos Las (6f, good) and he could have more to offer in the headgear; interesting contender for trainer who has won three of the last seven runnings.
runners.comment: Blistering pace when easily making all in cheekpieces at Ffos Las; interesting contender

runners.name: Night In Vegas
runners.spotlight: Won over 6f on first two starts (a conditions race here on the second occasion) before close fifth in the Coventry at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm) behind Adaay Of Scarlett and Cut A Dash; could be bang there.
runners.comment: 2-2 (including C&D) prior to close 5th in the Coventry at Royal Ascot; could be bang there

runners.name: Flann Sunna
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month and again had plenty in hand when streaking clear to follow up in a conditions race at Ascot (6f, good to firm); his stable won this in 2023 and he's an exciting prospect who could take today's rise in grade in his stride.
runners.comment: He's won his two races with plenty in hand and could take this rise in grade in his stride
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Cut A Dash
runners.spotlight: Impressive on debut at York's Dante meeting (5f, good) and confirmed that promise with close fourth in the Coventry at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm; Adaay Of Scarlett second); open to further improvement and he's firmly in calculations for a stable that has enjoyed plenty of success in this race.
runners.comment: Impressive on debut at York then close fourth at Royal Ascot; firmly in calculations

runners.name: Where Love Lives
runners.spotlight: Beat Hickory Lad to win for Kevin Ryan on debut at Thirsk (5f, good) and had subsequent Royal Ascot runner-up Adaay Of Scarlett in second when a Listed winner at Sandown (5f, good) in May; merely mid-division in the Norfolk at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) but he's better than that and it's possible the step up in trip will suit on his stable debut; not written off.
runners.comment: 2-2 (including Listed) prior to mid-division at Royal Ascot; not written off on yard debut

runners.name: Hickory Lad
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-4 when making all in the Woodcote conditions stakes at Epsom (6f, good to soft) on Oaks day; another good run when third of three in the Group 2 July Stakes at Newmarket three weeks ago (6f, good to firm; Adaay Of Scarlett second) but it's likely his limitations will again be exposed.
runners.comment: Won the Woodcote at Epsom; beaten in Group 2 since; limitations likely to be exposed

runners.name: Man's Best Friend
runners.spotlight: Improved upon his debut fourth at the Curragh (6f, good) in June when coming clear late on in a big-field maiden at Naas (6f, good) last Wednesday; others have more substance to their form but he's the sole Ballydoyle representative and could have lots more left in the tank.
runners.comment: Won big-field maiden at Naas on second start; the sole Ballydoyle runner in this
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Big Cigar
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Newcastle (6f, AW) before finding the drop to 5f against him at Beverley, and he was back on the scoresheet in a 6f nursery at York (6f, good to firm) last time; it was a Class 4 contest on the Knavesmire and this is considerably tougher, but he did it comfortably and the clear runner-up has won since; not ruled out each-way.
runners.comment: It was a Class 4 nursery he won at York but he did it comfortably; not ruled out each-way

runners.name: Mr Macartney
runners.spotlight: Unplaced on his three outings since winning at Leicester (5f, good to firm) in April on his second start, but he kept on nicely in a first-time visor (retained) when seventh of 21 in the Norfolk at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) last month, and he could outrun his forecast big odds back up to 6f.
runners.comment: Kept on for seventh in the 5f Norfolk at Royal Ascot; could outrun his odds back up to 6f

runners.name: Bay Of Brilliance
runners.spotlight: Pushed Maltese Cross all the way in Lingfield Derby Trial (11.6f, good to firm) and, although losing ground on that rival, fourth in the Derby at Epsom (1m4f, soft) was creditable; however, needs to bounce back from the German Derby (1m4f, soft) in which he was favourite but tailed off.
runners.comment: Lingfield Derby Trial 2nd and Derby 4th, but he was tailed-off favourite in German Derby

runners.name: Shaihaan
runners.spotlight: Sole win from seven races was a 1m2f maiden in March but he's also contested four Group events; best form when third in the Group 3 Gallinule at the Curragh (1m2f, good; unraced on firmer) in May, before weakening to a 13l defeat when fifth there in the Irish Derby (1m4f); that leaves his stamina unproven but his dam was suited by the trip.
runners.comment: Irish Derby fifth leaves his stamina unproven but his dam was suited by the trip

runners.name: Sahara King
runners.spotlight: Useful form in defeat, coming from the back, on all starts this season; best form when losing out narrowly in the London Gold Cup at Newbury (1m2f, good) before he never threatened when cheekpieces went on at Royal Ascot (1m2f, good to firm; 6-1); gelded since; while 1m4f may now be worth a go (he's not really bred for it) he needs improvement on this move from handicaps.
runners.comment: While 1m4f may now be worth a go, he needs improvement moving from handicaps; gelded now

runners.name: Magnetude
runners.spotlight: Can make the running; won two 1m4f handicaps and so nearly got back up over 1m6f at Newmarket on latest start; no show, however, when he tried a 1m6f Group 3 at Royal Ascot (100-1) and he is bottom of this pack on ratings.
runners.comment: Won two 1m4f handicaps and so nearly got back up over 1m6f latest start; bottom on ratings

runners.name: Venetian Lace
runners.spotlight: Second in the Group 1 Fillies' Mile at Newmarket last October (good) and returned there with a fine third in the 1,000 Guineas (good to firm); tailed-off last, however, in the Oaks at Epsom (1m4f, testing ground) and the Group 1 Falmouth at Newmarket (1m, good to firm); while bred to stay at least 1m2f, she now has a big question to answer.
runners.comment: Third in the 1,000 Guineas; tailed-off last, however, in the Oaks (1m4f) and Falmouth (1m)
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Enceladus
runners.spotlight: Won a good duel for maiden at Cork (10.5f, good to yielding) in April and followed up in a 19-runner race for handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) six weeks ago, challenging entering the straight and tenaciously keeping the rest at bay; no harm for the Ascot form that the second hacked up last Friday and the third was a close third in Listed race; scopey sort who looks open to further improvement and should be a leading player.
runners.comment: Won handicap debut at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) and open to further improvement

runners.name: Geryon
runners.spotlight: Ran in two Group 2s as 2yo and progressive at Listed/Group 3 levels this season, winning well at Leopardstown (1m1f, good) two weeks ago when he reverted to front-running; probably stayed 1m2f on penultimate start, without shouting that he's a 1m4f horse.
runners.comment: 1m1f Group 3 winner latest; probably stayed 1m2f time before, without shouting for 1m4f

runners.name: Diamond Necklace
runners.spotlight: Her 5-5 record includes French Group 1 wins on her last three starts, with this season's coming in the Poule d'Essai Des Pouliches at Longchamp (1m, heavy) and the Prix de Diane at Chantilly (10.5f, good to firm); it was a very tight finish last time but she's clearly a top performer and her trainer has won this with 3yos six times, including the last two runnings; leading claims.
runners.comment: 5-5, including French Group 1 wins on her last three starts; leading claims
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Friendly Soul
runners.spotlight: Won the Group 1 Prix de l'Opera at Longchamp (1m2f, very soft) in October 2024; stepped in a hidden drainage hole and pulled up at Haydock this May when returning from a very long absence, but looked as good as ever when third in the Group 2 Duke of Cambridge Stakes at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month, staying on well having been denied a clear run; could play a leading role back up in trip.
runners.comment: Group 1 winner in 2024; very promising third at Royal Ascot on second run back from layoff

runners.name: See The Fire
runners.spotlight: Beaten just a neck in this race in 2024 (good to firm) and heavy ground was against her when a below-par third 12 months ago; won the Group 2 Middleton Stakes at York (1m2f, good) this May for the second year running; well beaten in the Prince of Wales's Stakes at Royal Ascot last month and now 0-13 in Group 1 races, but she's still entitled to respect back against her own sex.
runners.comment: Went close in this race in 2024; 0-13 in Group 1 races but still entitled to respect

runners.name: Botagoz
runners.spotlight: 2-2 prior to keeping on well for third in 1m Listed race at York (good) in May and she improved for the step up to 1m2f to win the Group 3 Hoppings Stakes by a short head at Newcastle (AW) last month, coming clear with a classy Godolphin 5yo; others have stronger form but she's unexposed and well worth a crack at a Group 1; could give a good account.
runners.comment: Improved for the step up in trip for 1m2f AW win; unexposed and worth a crack at a Group 1

runners.name: Moments Of Joy
runners.spotlight: Group 3 runner-up at the Curragh last August but unplaced on her four runs since and it's likely she'll assume a pacemaking role for stablemate Diamond Necklace, as was the case in the Prix de Diane last time.
runners.comment: Likely to be a pacemaker for stablemate Diamond Necklace, as was the case last time
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Shes Got A Brother
runners.spotlight: Progressive 3yo who has moved on from her opening 5f wins on the AW with a good third of 16 to Naana's Shadow in the 3yo Dash at Epsom in June then setting a strong pace in an Ayr Listed race (5f, soft) when hanging on for fifth; goes without aids for the first time and is 5lb higher back in a handicap but she may well continue to go the right way.
runners.comment: Improving; solid 3rd in 3yo Dash and good effort from the front in Listed race since

runners.name: Truly Glamorous
runners.spotlight: Has come into his own in 5f handicaps for this yard, looking ahead of his mark when winning cosily at Newbury (good to firm) latest, despite hanging away from the whip; has a much stiffer task in this company but his dam won this race for the stable in 2020 when wearing first-time cheekpieces, as her son does today; just out of the weights but intriguing.
runners.comment: Dam won race for the yard in 2020; toughest task to date but a big improver; intriguing

runners.name: Naana's Shadow
runners.spotlight: Has won three of four 5f turf handicaps for this yard, including the 3yo Dash at Epsom and a narrow defeat of Schrodinger's Cat at York in June; has since done well in a Listed race there (good to firm) considering the tough task she faced at the weights; has good chance back in a handicap.
runners.comment: Has won three of four 5f turf handicaps for this yard; creditable Listed run latest

runners.name: Old Is Gold
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 5f 2yo conditions race at Beverley (good) and later a good third in 6f handicap at this meeting (good to soft); never best placed after a slow start on Sandown comeback when better than the bare result in sixth but he was withdrawn after getting upset in the stalls in May and his chance is likely to depend on what happens before the race starts in earnest.
runners.comment: Slowly away so creditable 6th on Sandown comeback; withdrawn after upset in stalls since

runners.name: Noble Vow
runners.spotlight: Followed a Bath maiden win (firm) with an impressive return to handicap company at Haydock (5f, good to soft) in May; saddle slipped when down the field later that month and he's been gelded since; 7lb higher mark than at Haydock may not be too much to ask and he's one of the more interesting ones.
runners.comment: Impressive in 5f handicap at Haydock; saddle slipped latest start; may well do better

runners.name: Coyy
runners.spotlight: Added to an earlier Windsor win when beating three rivals at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) last week; ran respectably in a less competitive C&D race than this in May but a tendency to get behind early is a worry in this big field and he's 3lb badly in under a penalty.
runners.comment: Beat his 3 rivals at Nottingham last week; 3lb badly in with penalty and often slowly away

runners.name: Schrodinger's Cat
runners.spotlight: In fine form over 5f and although he paid a high handicapping price for a wide-margin Redcar win in June, he so nearly overcame the 8lb rise at York next time against Naana's Shadow; had more to do at Ascot (good to firm) after but produced another sterling effort in a close sixth of 15; solid claims back against his own age group.
runners.comment: In fine form; has shot up the weights but close 6th at Ascot latest; can go well again

runners.name: River Spey
runners.spotlight: All races at about 6f, looking likely to find his feet at an even better level when beating a fair type at Windsor (good to firm) in June; lost his chance at the start at Newmarket since and remains one to be interested in; however, this very quick 5f may be an eye-opener for him.
runners.comment: Lost chance at the start latest but improved to win over 6f previously; first run over 5f

runners.name: Quantum Power
runners.spotlight: Has proved ideally suited by 5f on good to firm and, despite taking a hefty rise for two June wins, he didn't take much urging to get to the front at Newmarket last time, before nudged out to hold the second; a further 5lb rise in a better race asks for more but he should be in contention; yard won this in 2019.
runners.comment: Hat-trick of 5f wins on good to firm; up further 5lb in a better race but in contention

runners.name: Call Margot
runners.spotlight: Capable of much better than she showed on good to soft ground at Hamilton six weeks ago, such as when dashing home, after finally getting a clear run, to divide Naana's Shadow and Shes Got A Brother in the 3yo Dash at Epsom (good); no surprise to see her revive back on more suitable ground.
runners.comment: Disappointing on good to soft latest; capable of a strong showing on previous 2nd at Epsom

runners.name: Kolkata Knight
runners.spotlight: Won at both sprint trips as a 2yo but he hasn't been at the forefront of calculations in three turf handicaps this year and has ground to make up on Quantum Power on their recent Newmarket run; looks to have his share of weight and fitting a tongue-tie needs to make a difference.
runners.comment: Held in three turf handicaps this year; now tongue tied; has his share of weight

runners.name: Miss Yechance
runners.spotlight: Two 5f wins for other yards in a Catterick novice as 2yo and a Meydan handicap in January; along with 25 others she was outclassed by a handicap blot at Royal Ascot (5f, good to firm) on yard debut but less than 2l covered the second and seventh (where she finished; raced without a shoe) and there could be better to come for her leading trainer.
runners.comment: Creditable yard debut when seventh at Royal Ascot (5f); there could be better to come

runners.name: Baker Blue
runners.spotlight: Front-running winner of two AW races for this yard, at 6f and 5f; 0-9 on turf but he had big tasks either side of a break and he's likely to find this sharp test more to his liking than the one at Pontefract 13 days ago, when he was headed only near the line; likely to give a punchy show.
runners.comment: Two front-running wins at 6f/5f on AW; headed close home on turf latest; sharp 5f can suit

runners.name: Pilu
runners.spotlight: Often leads; won first two juvenile starts (extended 5f and 6f); placed only once in three 6f starts this year but he remains capable of better and, following a flagging fifth of 13 at Newmarket recently, he's worth a look in this first attempt over a bare 5f for yard that won this in 2021.
runners.comment: Won first two juvenile starts; capable of improvement on 2026 form; first run over bare 5f

runners.name: One And Gone
runners.spotlight: On the go since his debut last August but never better than of late, making all over this C&D in June and scraping home at Sandown (good) since; needs to find further new reserves after another 3lb rise.
runners.comment: Tough sort; never better than of late, following C&D win with one at Sandown; more needed

runners.name: Manatee Mehmas
runners.spotlight: Bright start to career when justifying short odds at Doncaster (5f, good to firm) in April and, after two defeats in Listed races, he made some late headway into third, beaten nearly 3l, behind Naana's Shadow and Schrodinger's Cat on handicap debut at York (5f, good); lacks experience generally and also of a downhill track but he has potential.
runners.comment: Won debut at 5f in April; good 3rd on handicap debut at York; has potential

runners.name: Dazzling Haze
runners.spotlight: All three wins over 5f on sharp tracks, most recently when making all at Thirsk (good) in May; found out by Ascot's stiffer test and tough company at the Royal meeting in June and needs another push to win off her current mark.
runners.comment: Suited by 5f on sharp tracks but needs another push to win this off current mark

runners.name: U S S Charleston
runners.spotlight: Off the mark on turf when wide-margin winner at Yarmouth (5f, soft) in May and he did well to finish within 2l of Naana's Shadow in the 3yo Dash at Epsom next time as he took a while to pick up; two lesser efforts have followed, though, and he looks vulnerable.
runners.comment: Solid 5th in the 3yo Dash at Epsom; vulnerable on two lesser efforts since

runners.name: Shadow King
runners.spotlight: Last of three here in his penultimate race but successful either side of that, getting up close home on last week's nursery debut at Doncaster (extended 6f; good to firm; first-time blinkers); the penalty has to spell danger in this much deeper handicap.
runners.comment: Narrow winner last week; the penalty has to spell danger in this much deeper handicap
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Cilician
runners.spotlight: Bang there in three of his four races (the last two over 7f) and he was only 5l away when 66-1 for the Coventry on his second start; likely to give his running once more, but he's probably vulnerable off this mark unless first-time cheekpieces can make a difference.
runners.comment: He's probably vulnerable off this mark unless new cheekpieces can make a difference

runners.name: Cash Cove
runners.spotlight: Her standout RPR came in the 7f maiden win at Doncaster last month (good to firm); however, she had no apparent excuses when behind The Ginger Kid on nursery debut at Chester and she's been dealt a wicked draw.
runners.comment: No apparent excuses when behind The Ginger Kid on her nursery debut at Chester

runners.name: Crazy Cubana
runners.spotlight: Came from well behind to win at Nottingham in May (6f, good) before outclassed in the Albany (100-1) at Royal Ascot; seemed to see out 7f fine when a close third of five in her first nursery at Lingfield (AW) but that was Class 5 and this race demands plenty more from her; wears first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Close third of five on 7f nursery debut (AW); this demands plenty more; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Mia Fantasia
runners.spotlight: Both runs over 7f on good to firm; out of a 1m4f winner; looked nice when overcoming a slow start to win comfortably at Carlisle and he chased home respected opposition in a good time at Ascot (the winner Dr Rascal won Tuesday's Vintage Stakes); there's no doubt he has better to come and Oisin Murphy is often a significant booking for this yard.
runners.comment: Impressed on debut and chased home respected opposition at Ascot; better to come

runners.name: Wise And Wonderful
runners.spotlight: From last year's successful stable; bred for further but has improved with each run and was nicely on top late on when making all in a 7f maiden at Epsom one month ago (good); she'll do well to adopt the same tactics here from stall 14 but likely to finish her race off well.
runners.comment: Made all at Epsom and will do well to adopt the same tactics here from stall 14

runners.name: Rbflying
runners.spotlight: Four starts (5f/6f); suffered interference when beating one home on his nursery debut at York (6f) but he was 28-1 and this race is no easier.
runners.comment: Suffered interference on nursery debut but was 28-1 and this race is no easier

runners.name: Everatease
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten since upped to 6f and, although both races were sellers, the latest at York (won well) is always a strong race for the grade and connections retained his services for £30,000; stall 16 could pose problems but this colt is firmly on the upgrade and 7f could suit.
runners.comment: Has won only sellers but the latest at York is often strong; bought back in for £30,000

runners.name: The Bookkeeper
runners.spotlight: Made his debut over 5f and it was at 7f that he got off the mark in a small field at Haydock (good to soft); tackled 6f in the Woodcote at Epsom (good to soft) and finished to some effect to take fourth; returning to further can be beneficial and Ryan Moore has a good draw to work with.
runners.comment: An improved fourth in the Woodcote and returning to 7f should be beneficial

runners.name: High Hazard
runners.spotlight: Beaten at Thirsk and Beverley (twice) at trips over about 7f and, unless transformed by a recent gelding operation, he'll do well to get involved from the widest stall.
runners.comment: Unless transformed by a recent gelding op, he'll do well to get involved from stall 18

runners.name: My A'Ali Baba
runners.spotlight: First two runs were over 6f and gelded after; took quite a strong hold at Sandown (7f, good) recently, so it's to his credit that he rallied for third, just behind Cilician; open to improvement in this bigger-field scenario, and David Evans appears to mean business in booking Colin Keane.
runners.comment: His third at Sandown can be upgraded and Colin Keane is a positive jockey booking

runners.name: Sword Salute
runners.spotlight: All runs 7f on good or good to firm; comfortably won a Lingfield maiden before 66-1 in the Chesham at Royal Ascot and performing accordingly, so his Group 1 entry in Ireland looks optimistic; the stable's handicappers always need a second look here but he wouldn't be the obvious answer.
runners.comment: Maiden winner who finished out the back in the Chesham; Group 1 entry looks optimistic
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: The Ginger Kid
runners.spotlight: Narrowly repelled Cilician off level weights in a 6f novice at Nottingham in early June, after which he failed to fire in the Coventry at Royal Ascot; upped to 7f for nursery debut in a small field at Chester (good) and that race didn't go entirely to plan behind the winner who ran quite well in Listed race at Ascot last week; handily drawn and could have a part to play.
runners.comment: Novice winner who ran in the Coventry; nursery debut (2nd) didn't go entirely to plan

runners.name: Caeruleus
runners.spotlight: Three runs over 6f in the north, last time at Newcastle (AW) where staying on the best to deny an odds-on Gosden inmate; looks ready for 7f, as pedigree would suggest with his dam a daughter of Galileo; enters the reckoning on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Progressive, last time staying on the best over 6f on Newcastle AW; looks ready for 7f

runners.name: Primal
runners.spotlight: Had considerable traffic issues when behind The Ginger Kid and Cilician on his debut but he hasn't kicked on from there, weakening last time at Newbury when raised to 7f (again behind Cilician); needs to be seen in a very different light if he's to feature on nursery debut.
runners.comment: Needs to be seen in a very different light if he's to feature on nursery debut

runners.name: Agitator
runners.spotlight: All runs over 6f on good or faster ground; a Windsor winner in May but he suffered heavy defeats either side of that, latterly in the Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot (125-1); pedigree firmly points towards this trip suiting him better, but he isn't overly appealing with cheekpieces now turned to.
runners.comment: A Windsor winner in May but suffered heavy defeats either side of that; up in trip

runners.name: Rocket Boots
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who was too free in a 6f Newmarket novice in May and the cheekpieces enlisted there are swiftly removed; this initial mark looks on the high side even if he's judged on his Doncaster second the run before.
runners.comment: Excuses last time but, even if judged on his previous second, this mark looks high

runners.name: Leave The Bag In
runners.spotlight: Scopey colt who was all the better for being gelded when going down by a neck at Catterick (7f, good to soft; tried to make all) and the winner has since defied a penalty at Sandown, beating Cilician and My A'Ali Baba; shrewd trainer has secured Toby Moore's useful claim and stall 1 is ideal should he again go from the front; wears first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Narrowly denied by a useful winner at Catterick; respected with Toby Moore claiming 7lb

races.race_name: Tatler British EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Avalon Queen
runners.spotlight: By Masar out of smart 1m2f-1m4f winner; has made a bright start to her career with minor honours at Newbury (good to firm) over 6.5f and 6f, finishing well last time after jockey lost an iron; just about sets the form standard and, although better will surely be needed, could produce another big run.
runners.comment: Bright start to her career with minor honours at Newbury (good to firm) over 6.5f and 6f

runners.name: So Lovely
runners.spotlight: By Wootton Bassett, while dam Love won on her third start as 2yo before going on to take the Group 1 Moyglare as 2yo and complete the 1,000 Guineas/Oaks double; weak 6-1 for maiden at Leopardstown (1m, good) two weeks ago and ran on well from the back for second of six; has her own Moyglare entry for top connections and their runners tend to improve markedly.
runners.comment: Illustrious pedigree; ran on well from the back for 2nd of six at Leopardstown (1m, good)
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Clarity
runners.spotlight: 115,000gns breeze-up 2yo by Blue Point; 9-2 for novice at Kempton (6f, AW) three weeks ago, coming from towards rear for third of nine; found her stride in good style late on, so could be a significant improver.
runners.comment: 115,000gns breeze-up 2yo; found her stride in good style late on for Kempton 3rd (6f, AW)

runners.name: Elevating
runners.spotlight: Showcasing close relation to 5f winner Fashion Queen (including 2yo/Listed; RPR 106); second favourite, kept on well from off the pace when second of eight in novice at York (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; firmly in the mix among those who have run.
runners.comment: Second favourite, kept on well from off pace when 2nd of eight at York (6f, good to firm)

runners.name: Beguiled
runners.spotlight: 72,000gns yearling by Make Believe; first foal; dam 1m1f/1m4f winner (RPR 97), half-sister to 1m/9.5f Group 2 winner Military Law, out of 1m Group 3 winner; from a top yard, so needs a close look.
runners.comment: 72,000gns yearling by Make Believe; dam 1m1f/1m4f winner (RPR 97); from a top yard

runners.name: Cloud Chorus
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros foal, £40,000 yearling, 62,000gns breeze-up 2yo by Starspangledbanner; sixth foal; half-sister to Italian 1m1f/1m3f winner Aretino; dam unplaced at 1m (RPR 65), sister to bumper and useful 2m-2m3f hurdle/chase winner Stamp Your Feet, half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Memory; hooded for debut; yard had a newcomer win at this meeting in 2017.
runners.comment: 62,000gns breeze-up 2yo by Starspangledbanner; hooded for debut

runners.name: Highland Girl
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; Sea The Moon half-sister to six winners including Notation (1m-2m AW, including KSA; RPR 102), Temporize (1m4f-2m4f; 98) and Cool Party (8.5f-2m including 2yo; 97); dam 1m4f-1m6f winner (98); late foal; newcomer for trainer who also runs Donna Beauty and the market can give clues.
runners.comment: Sea The Moon half-sister to six winners, 3 useful; dam 1m4f-1m6f winner (98); late foal

runners.name: Siena Storm
runners.spotlight: 180,000gns yearling, 600,000euros breeze-up 2yo by Night Of Thunder; first foal; dam 1m2f winner (RPR 80), closely related to 1m Listed winner Token Of Love (dam of 7f/1m Group 3 winner Mighty Ulysses), out of Listed-placed half-sister to 1m Group 1 winner Rebecca Sharp; major yard had two good 2yo winners at Ascot last week, so market strength should be a big pointer.
runners.comment: 600,000euros breeze-up 2yo by Night Of Thunder; yard had two 2yo wins at Ascot last week

runners.name: Majestic Flame
runners.spotlight: 35,000gns foal, 52,000gns yearling; fourth foal; Pinatubo half-sister to winners Live Each Day (7f-1m3f; RPR 74), Fermain (6f 2yo; 70) and Grand Oak (US 5f turf including 2yo); dam 5.5f-7f winner (including 2yo) out of 6f 2yo Listed winner; trainer had two 2yo winners (with experience) on Monday.
runners.comment: 52,000gns yearling by Pinatubo; trainer had two 2yo winners (with experience) on Monday

runners.name: Iconic Dream
runners.spotlight: Third foal; Harry Angel half-sister to 6f AW winner Iconic Times (including 2yo; RPR 79); dam runner-up at 6f (63), half-sister to fairly useful winners, out of 7f winner; her trainer's first 2yo runner this term.
runners.comment: Harry Angel half-sister to 6f AW winner (RPR 79); her trainer's first 2yo runner this term

runners.name: La Bassette
runners.spotlight: 160,000euros yearling by Wootton Bassett; second foal; dam US 6f turf winner, half-sister to winners Guildsman (US 6.5f Grade 3) and La Galiote (French 7.5f/1m), out of maiden half-sister to dam of 1m2f/10.5f Group 1 winner Almanzor; worth a second look for yard whose 2yos are doing well.
runners.comment: 160,000euros yearling by Wootton Bassett; second foal; dam US 6f turf winner

runners.name: Orchard Hatches
runners.spotlight: By Time Test; second foal; dam 1m3f winner (RPR 76), out of maiden half-sister to French 1m2f Group 1 winners Vadawina and Vazira; trainer off the mark with his 2026 juveniles last week.
runners.comment: By Time Test; dam 1m3f winner (RPR 76); trainer off the mark with 2026 juveniles last week

runners.name: State Of America
runners.spotlight: 90,000euros yearling by State Of Rest; third foal; half-sister to winners Sounds Like A Plan (6f-1m including 2yo/HK; RPR 95) and Reprised (6f AW; 80); dam 5f 2yo winner (including Listed; 98) out of 1m Listed winner; from an in-form stable which had 2yo wins (their first of the season) last Friday and Saturday.
runners.comment: 90,000euros yearling by State Of Rest; in-form yard had 2yo wins last Friday and Saturday

runners.name: Donna Beauty
runners.spotlight: 35,000gns half-sister to winners including Grocer Jack (1m2f/10.5f including German/Italian Group 3; RPR 116); 12-1, green when beaten nearly 9l in novice at Newmarket (5f, good to firm) in early May; needs big improvement with the hood enlisted.
runners.comment: 12-1, green when beaten nearly 9l at Newmarket (5f, good to firm) in early May; now hooded

runners.name: Get Outta Here
runners.spotlight: Won on handicap debut at Lingfield (7.6f, good to firm) in May then went very close over this C&D (good) where he had to wait for a run; made good headway from the rear before his effort flattened out at York (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago, finishing third; could have a part to play.
runners.comment: Has continued in good form (including C&D) since Lingfield win; could have a part to play

runners.name: Go Rimbaud
runners.spotlight: Won Kempton maiden (1m, AW) in April on fourth start then finished fifth on handicap debut at Haydock (1m, good to firm); gelded prior to winning four-runner handicap at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) a fortnight ago; up in grade and needs to prove he's fully effective on turf, but he's from a fine family and represents a top yard; respected in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Small-field AW win a fortnight ago; from a fine family and with top yard; respected

runners.name: Law Court
runners.spotlight: Progressive this term and he got off the mark at Sandown (1m, good) in May on his second handicap start; couldn't quite get there when second of five at Sandown (1m1f, good) since but the expected competitive gallop in this big field should be right up his street, and he's one to consider.
runners.comment: Progressive sort who has been in good form at Sandown and should have the race run to suit

runners.name: Zennor Storm
runners.spotlight: Won both 2yo starts and, having been gelded, he returned to form when keeping on for fourth of 14 at York (1m, good) last month; retains potential for top yard and the first-time cheekpieces could elicit something extra.
runners.comment: Kept on for fourth of 14 at York and the cheekpieces could elicit something extra

runners.name: Abundant
runners.spotlight: Close third over C&D in June on second handicap start (good; Get Outta Here second) and filled the same position at Ascot (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago, albeit no match for the first two; he might have an each-way shout in first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Third on his last two starts (C&D on first occasion) and might have an each-way shout

runners.name: Kalokalo
runners.spotlight: Won at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) in June and at Southwell (1m, AW) on July 5; did well to finish third at Windsor (1m, good to firm) last time having hung badly left, which he also did when winning there; it remains to be seen how he'll cope with the camber in the straight at this tricky track, but he has plenty of ability provided it's harnessed in the right direction.
runners.comment: Not straightforward and this is a tricky track, but he's won two of his last four

runners.name: Mr Seagull
runners.spotlight: He's yet to pose a serious threat this season but has run some respectable races, as when keeping on from the rear for fifth at Ascot (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago; edging down the weights and this big-field scenario and expected strong pace could see him to good effect; interesting.
runners.comment: Not threatening but this big-field scenario could see him to good effect; interesting
runners.owner: Two Plus Three Two Plus Four

runners.name: Storming Point
runners.spotlight: He's finished in the first three on all four starts and was stretched by 1m2f when turned over at odds-on last time; wears first-time cheekpieces on handicap debut and his stable won this in 2023; Ryan Moore rides and improvement is possible, but necessary if he's to defy his opening mark.
runners.comment: In the first 3 on all 4 starts; Ryan Moore rides but improvement needed on handicap debut

runners.name: Wild Thoughts
runners.spotlight: 4-4 in handicaps (1m/7f) prior to clear second to thriving winner at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) in May; disappointing at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago in first-time cheekpieces (retained) and something to prove on the back of that, but not written off in view of previous form.
runners.comment: Disappointing at Newmarket three weeks ago but not written off in view of previous form

runners.name: Loblolly
runners.spotlight: Twice finished third behind Law Court and The Joker at Sandown (1m/1m1f, good) then finished fourth of eight there (1m2f, good to firm); he's raced ten times, with one win, and improvement is needed in this hot contest.
runners.comment: In the frame on his last four starts; one win from his ten outings; improvement is needed

runners.name: Euston Hall
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with a win at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) in April and he followed up on his handicap debut at Newbury (1m, good); represents in-form yard and he's probably capable of better than he showed when sixth of ten over C&D (good) last month, but others arrive with more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Won on handicap debut at Newbury in May but only sixth of ten over C&D since

runners.name: Aqua Bear
runners.spotlight: He's raced in four handicaps this year and has twice made the frame (7f/1m, good/good to firm); however, he was well beaten at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago and needs to bounce back with a career-best effort.
runners.comment: He's twice made the frame this year but well beaten last time and has to bounce back

runners.name: Exclusive Code
runners.spotlight: Built upon 2yo promise to win big-field maiden at Newbury (1m, good) on reappearance and when 13th of 30 in the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) he was third of 15 in the far-side group; possible player.
runners.comment: 3rd of 15 in far-side group when 13th overall in Britannia at Royal Ascot; possible player

runners.name: Intense Vision
runners.spotlight: Won in France last autumn on his two 2yo starts (6.5f/1m, soft/very soft); however, soundly beaten in an AW conditions race and Royal Ascot handicap on his two outings this year and he needs to raise his game.
runners.comment: 2-2 in France last year but soundly beaten on his two outings this season

runners.name: Dumuji
runners.spotlight: Won at Kempton (7f, AW) last November on sole 2yo start; fifth on both outings this season, most recently on handicap debut at Windsor (1m, good to firm) when beaten 3l; very lightly raced and improvement can't be ruled out, but he certainly needs to take a step forward today.
runners.comment: Fifth on handicap debut at Windsor; very lightly raced but needs to take a step forward

runners.name: Runswick
runners.spotlight: He's got better with each of this year's three runs and he got back on the scoresheet when making all with something to spare at Carlisle (1m, good to firm) last month; 6lb higher in a tougher race today but this progressive colt could make another bold bid.
runners.comment: Made all with something to spare at Carlisle; progressive and could make another bold bid

runners.name: Electric Dreams
runners.spotlight: Made debut in April and he improved upon his first two runs when winning by a short head at Leicester (1m, good) last month; he's not obviously well treated off his opening mark but he cost 475,000gns as a yearling and is in good hands to continue to progress; Oisin Murphy has an excellent record for the yard in the last five seasons (18-39; 46%).
runners.comment: Narrowly won a maiden at Leicester last month and is in good hands to continue to progress

runners.name: Vincenzo Peruggia
runners.spotlight: Fast-ground 2yo novice winner who reappeared with good second in a handicap at Musselburgh (1m, good to soft) in April; however, two lesser runs have followed; gelded since and has to get back on track.
runners.comment: Reappeared with good second at Musselburgh but two lesser runs have followed; gelded since

runners.name: Richie's Rocket
runners.spotlight: 9l maiden win at Lingfield (7f, AW) last November and reappeared with close Listed fourth there (7f) in February; he's dropped down the weights but his turf form on his last four starts hasn't come up to scratch.
runners.comment: Listed fourth on AW in February but subsequent turf form hasn't come up to scratch

runners.name: Celtic Moon
runners.spotlight: Improved from her Leopardstown debut on soft to win a 1m Bellewstown maiden on good ground; opening mark seems fair enough, getting weight from four maidens.
runners.comment: No stamina doubts judged on her 1m win at Bellewstown, opening mark seems fair enough

runners.name: Winnie's Wish
runners.spotlight: Has shown little in maidens; in receipt of plenty of weight from his seven rivals; however, he is 3lb out of the handicap.
runners.comment: Has shown little in maidens, in receipt of plenty of weight but is 3lb out of the handicap

runners.name: Bold Commander
runners.spotlight: Has been running over shorter distances; best run when second over 5f at Bellewstown; tame effort over the same trip at the Curragh last time; may improve over this trip; rider's claim an asset.
runners.comment: Has been running over shorter distances, tame effort last time, may improve over this trip
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Eighteenth Smiles
runners.spotlight: Limited appeal on maiden form; first time with cheekpieces; Seven Nation Army appears to give the yard a better chance.
runners.comment: Limited appeal on maiden form, Seven Nation Army appears to give the yard a better chance

runners.name: Banks Of The Boyne
runners.spotlight: Showed little on his first two starts; was able to dictate in a 6f Fairyhouse maiden and gave a much-improved display to take second; opening mark looks quite stiff.
runners.comment: Was able to dictate in a 6f Fairyhouse maiden and gave a much-improved display

runners.name: I Ready
runners.spotlight: Similar standard of form in 6f maiden at the Curragh (good) on debut and when fifth at Fairyhouse (6f, good); mid-field at Navan on third start; reacted well to the addition of cheekpieces when a narrow winner from Seven Nation Army in a 6f nursery at the Curragh; good 7lb claimer counters 7lb rise.
runners.comment: Narrow winner from Seven Nation Army at the Curragh, good 7lb claimer counters 7lb rise

runners.name: Seven Nation Army
runners.spotlight: Given three runs in nine days in May to get a handicap mark; none of his efforts was particularly notable; gelded before bringing an intriguing profile to his first handicap at the Curragh; ran a bit green when fighting out the finish and lost out narrowly to I Ready; trip should suit, may cope with extra 5lb.
runners.comment: Narrowly beaten by I Ready on handicap debut, trip should suit, may cope with extra 5lb

races.race_name: Arthur Guinness Irish EBF Corrib Fillies Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Meriden
runners.spotlight: One of the stars of the season; started a five-race winning sequence by scoring off 57 at Ballinrobe two months ago; now an astonishing 46lb higher after four handicap wins (including a fillies' premier contest at the Curragh) and a Killarney Listed success at the main expense of Royal Ascot handicap winner Green Carrera; tough, ground-versatile; stiff 7f should suit.
runners.comment: Hugely progressive, up a total of 46lb for five wins, another is not out of the question
runners.owner: Patrick John O'Brien & Mrs Paul Shanahan

runners.name: La Brodeuse
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced French winner (1m, soft); bright start for her new connections when runner-up in a Group 3 at Lingfield (7f, good to firm) in May; not in the same form when fourth in a Listed race at Musselburgh (7f, good) in June.
runners.comment: Runner-up in a Group 3 at Lingfield on stable debut, less encouraging run at Musselburgh
runners.owner: Mrs R G Hillen And Partner

runners.name: Black Caviar Gold
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner at the Curragh (7f, soft) last September and runner-up in the same grade there (1m, good) in May; fourth in the Irish 1,000 Guineas at the Curragh (1m, good), beaten around 6l; sights lowered considerably now after ambitious Coronation Stakes run; new headgear combination.
runners.comment: Solid Group 3 form, good chance she can take advantage of drop in class after Group 1 runs

runners.name: Pivotal Attack
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D maiden in good style last year; has run well in defeat in Pattern company over this trip, second to Black Caviar Gold last autumn, and third (behind True Love) at Leopardstown in April; last two runs have been in 1m races, held by Black Caviar Gold on Irish 1,000 Guineas running and has a 3 1/2l to find with Meriden on Killarney running.
runners.comment: Held by Black Caviar Gold on Irish 1,000 Guineas clash, fourth behind Meriden at Killarney

runners.name: Celestial Orbit
runners.spotlight: Ran nine times for Ollie Sangster, winning twice as a 2yo, also Listed-placed last season; excellent debut for this stable when winning Group 3 at the Curragh in April (1m, soft-to-heavy); backed up that run in less testing conditions when beaten 3l into seventh in Group 2; now has to bounce back from a disappointing Leopardstown run; cheekpieces on.
runners.comment: Ground conditions were testing for her Group 3 win on Irish debut, below-par on latest
runners.owner: J P Magnier/Mrs P Shanahan/Mrs M V Magnier/K MacLennan

runners.name: Greydreambeliever
runners.spotlight: No further success since debut win for Karl Burke at York two years ago; denied three times by the useful Rion Rubette in handicaps at Gowran this season; not one of her better runs at the Curragh last time; lowest-rated filly in the field.
runners.comment: Not one of her better runs at the Curragh last time, lowest-rated filly in the field
runners.owner: K Blake/Mrs E Palmer/M Wilson/N Luck

runners.name: Celtic Motif
runners.spotlight: Good maiden for this stable at two, made the frame on all four starts, notably when third in the Goffs Million and fourth (demoted from third) in a 1m fillies' Group 3 event; placed in three of her four starts for Brendan Walsh in the US; had a confidence-boosting win against much inferior opposition at Killarney.
runners.comment: Useful for this stable at two, had a spell in the US, beat weak opposition at Killarney

runners.name: Goldilocks Cen
runners.spotlight: Won a Dieppe maiden (1m3f, heavy) just over a year ago; not seen again until well held on her stable debut in the Kensington Palace at Ascot (1m, good to firm); decent effort when fifth at 33-1 in a Listed race at Pontefract; aiming high again here.
runners.comment: Decent effort when fifth at 33-1 in a Listed race at Pontefract, aiming high again here

runners.name: Nancy J
runners.spotlight: Won a 2yo maiden on debut for Jessica Harrington; ran some good races in defeat last year; joined Johnny Murtagh this term; fair fourth behind Meriden at the Curragh in June; did well to finish third of six in a 7f Group 3 race at Leopardstown; however, that looked a sub-standard affair, and she may be flattered by the resultant 12lb rise to a mark of 95.
runners.comment: Third of six in a 7f Group 3 event at Leopardstown, this looks like a stronger race

runners.name: Noli Timere
runners.spotlight: Won races over 1m at Naas and Navan last August; final two 2025 starts in Listed races were ambitious; never in the hunt in the Irish Lincoln on reappearance; no luck in running at Limerick last time; stiff task in this grade.
runners.comment: Out of her depth in Listed races last season, no encouragement from this year's form

races.race_name: Guinness Open Gate Brewery Novice Chase (Grade 3)

runners.name: Shadow Paddy
runners.spotlight: Smart hurdler won four races in that sphere including in Listed company last year; pulled-up in a Grade 1 Aintree novice on return in April; quickly rebounded with a Limerick novice chase win over Le Coq Hardi and followed up at Killarney; already  looks a better chaser and respected despite a double penalty.
runners.comment: Smart hurdler looks a better chaser after just two starts and respected despite top-weight

runners.name: Le Coq Hardi
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner over shorter and has already had eight chase runs; beaten 12l by Shadow Paddy on return at Limerick but went one better at Kilbeggan since; cheekpieces added and needs more.
runners.comment: Beaten 12l by Shadow Paddy on return but went one better at Kilbeggan; cheekpieces added

runners.name: Lady Bluebird
runners.spotlight: Rated 105 over hurdles but performed above that level when winning on chase debut at Wexford, jumping well; however, this is much tougher and a place looks the best she can do.
runners.comment: Rated 105 over hurdles; jumped well when winning on chase debut at Wexford; this is harder

runners.name: Soir De Garde
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner is rated 130 in that sphere but lost his form after some poor jumping; didn't jump well when won on chase debut at Wexford either but can surely do better with that experience behind him.
runners.comment: Rated 130 over hurdles; didn't jump well when won on chase debut at Wexford; can do better

runners.name: Queenofthelodge
runners.spotlight: Rated 120 over hurdles with four wins to her name; was a ready winner on chase bow last time at Wexford; this is tougher but gets plenty of weight and can be a player.
runners.comment: Rated 120 over hurdles; ready winner on chase bow last time; this is harder but a player

runners.name: Wild Bill Hickok
runners.spotlight: Useful hurdler in France has won 2-3 over fences for this yard; won well at Wexford before disappointing there; however, was impressive at Roscommon next time; that was all over 2m but can be a big player if staying this trip.
runners.comment: Has won 2-3 over fences and was impressive at Roscommon; player if staying this trip

runners.name: Court Canyon
runners.spotlight: Clonmel maiden hurdle winner over this trip last year and rated 111 in that sphere; point winner took his form to a new level with a decisive chase debut win at Down Royal; this is tougher but can be involved.
runners.comment: Hurdle winner took his form to a new level with a decisive chase debut win; a player

runners.name: Midnight Jet
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner on debut for Sam Curling last year; didn't go on initially over hurdles for this yard but better this year, winning a Fairyhouse maiden and Killarney novice over this trip; is a leading player.
runners.comment: Bumper winner won a Fairyhouse maiden and Killarney novice this year; leading player

runners.name: Brother Walfrid
runners.spotlight: Point runner-up was second in a maiden hurdle on rules debut before a lesser bumper run; was happier back over obstacles when winning a 2m3f Punchestown maiden hurdle last time; has to do more but is improving; tongue-tie on.
runners.comment: Got off the mark in a Punchestown maiden hurdle last time; has to do more but improving

runners.name: Roc Dino
runners.spotlight: Placed over hurdles in France and some decent efforts initially in defeat for this yard including in Martin Pipe at Cheltenham;  easily won an uncompetitive Downpatrick maiden last time; solid chance.
runners.comment: Build on his fine Martin Pipe run when easily winning a Downpatrick maiden; solid chance

runners.name: Siege Of Carthage
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in bumpers without looking like a winner-in-waiting; however, was much-improved to run away with a Limerick maiden over this trip on hurdling debut; more to come and can be in the mix.
runners.comment: Much-improved to run away with a Limerick maiden over this trip last time; in the mix

runners.name: Rosie's Wings
runners.spotlight: Some decent bumper form for Lorna Fowler without winning; an improved effort to get off the mark in a 2m Punchestown maiden last time; up in trip and this is way tougher.
runners.comment: Got off the mark in a 2m Punchestown maiden last time; up in trip and this is way tougher

runners.name: Look Sport
runners.spotlight: By a top French sire but unsold for 25,000euros as a 3yo; looked green so did well to win a 2m2f Kilbeggan maiden hurdle on debut; this is way tougher but can't be dismissed either.
runners.comment: Looked green so did well to win a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle on debut; this is way tougher

runners.name: Royal Hollow
runners.spotlight: Three hurdle wins and six seconds, including a pleasing effort behind Murcia at Listowel in May; has run twice on the Flat since then, went close in a handicap at Ballinrobe, out of the money behind Tounsivator at Fairyhouse.
runners.comment: Three hurdle wins, pleasing second behind Murcia at Listowel in May, has recent Flat form

runners.name: Casheldale Lad
runners.spotlight: Highly creditable third behind Ndaawi here 12 months ago before winning a big 2m handicap at Listowel; faced a straightforward task in a three-runner contest at Down Royal before running well up to the point of his fall at the last in the 2m4f Hatton's Grace; fair third behind Lossiemouth at Leopardstown's Christmas meeting; 14lb higher than last year.
runners.comment: Creditable third behind Ndaawi here, 14lb higher now after Grade 1 runs, good 5lb claimer

runners.name: Gameball
runners.spotlight: Impressive winner of a Ballinrobe bumper for Andrew Slattery a year ago; won a Punchestown maiden hurdle last October on stable debut before finishing fourth in a Fairyhouse Grade 2 novice; third in a conditions event at the Punchestown festival; outstayed by an emphatic winner on handicap debut in a 2m4f contest at Kilbeggan.
runners.comment: Outstayed by an emphatic winner on handicap debut in a 2m4f contest at Kilbeggan

runners.name: Beauvallon
runners.spotlight: Flat maiden in France; made a couple of mistakes when winning a maiden hurdle at Limerick in March on his second run for Willie Mullins; again untidy at times when coping well with a marked step up in class to win a Punchestown festival conditions race; no match for a 10lb-receiving rival at Bellewstown; winner was trounced by a Mullins novice here on Monday.
runners.comment: Horses of his age have won two of the last three editions, needs to jump better

runners.name: Too Bossy For Us
runners.spotlight: Struggled in top company after a maiden win at Punchestown in February; one place behind Tounsivator when sixth in the amateur handicap on Monday.
runners.comment: Struggled in top company after maiden win, one place behind Tounsivator here on Monday

runners.name: Ragmans Corner
runners.spotlight: Opened his account off a modest mark of 94 in a C&D handicap hurdle in October 2024; has now obtained a rating of 132 after recording his fourth handicap success at Killarney in May; seldom runs a bad race and was placed twice at last year's festival, third in the big amateur handicap and second in a handicap hurdle.
runners.comment: Won at Killarney in May, seldom runs a bad race, placed twice at last year's festival

runners.name: Murcia
runners.spotlight: Grade 1 juvenile winner at Aintree (2m1f, gd-sft) in April 2025; best run last season when fourth at Leopardstown in February; struggled in valuable handicaps at three festivals, with soft ground probably to blame; regained the winning thread in mares' race at Listowel in May; beaten favourite for a similar race at Killarney; Paul Townend's choice, has to be taken seriously.
runners.comment: Failure in big handicaps can be attributed to soft ground, Paul Townend's choice

runners.name: Barbizon
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat for John Murphy, 2-4 and rated 101; failed to prosper as a juvenile hurdler for this stable after a winning introduction at Navan last November; completely tailed off in the Fred Winter; in rear in the Bellewstown race won by Putapoundinthejar.
runners.comment: Tailed off in the Fred Winter, in rear in the Bellewstown race won by Putapoundinthejar

runners.name: Solness
runners.spotlight: Three-time Grade 1-winning chaser who has counted Gaelic Warrior and Marine Nationale among his victims in top-level races; winner of two of his six races over hurdles, one in France at four, the other a three-runner Sligo contest two years ago; warmed up for this with a run on the Flat at the Curragh 11 days ago.
runners.comment: Best known as a three-time Grade 1-winning chaser, 2-6 over hurdles, had prep-run on Flat

runners.name: Ndaawi
runners.spotlight: Promoted winner of this race last year after receiving critical interference; has been mixing hurdling and Flat action since then, down the field in the County Hurdle; beat the very useful Absurde in a conditions' hurdle at Cork in April; kept ticking over with an odds-on Flat win in a 1m6f Listowel contest two months ago; 7lb higher than last year.
runners.comment: Promoted winner of this race last year, 7lb higher, in good shape on the Flat in May

runners.name: El Cairos
runners.spotlight: Smart bumper form; fell with race at his mercy on hurdles debut at Leopardstown in December; survived a final flight blunder to win a maiden at Thurles; best of the Irish in the Supreme Novices', though no threat from the last; faded quite tamely in Grade 1 at Punchestown; retains a good reputation and has been a leading ante-post fancy.
runners.comment: Ran in Grade 1 races at Cheltenham and Punchestown, leading ante-post fancy

runners.name: Sageborough
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden at Wexford on debut last October; next two races were highly ambitious, in the Royal Bond and the Supreme Novices'; struggled in a Cork conditions race won by Ndaawi; addition of a tongue-tie did the trick when he gained a second Wexford win in May.
runners.comment: Both wins have been gained at Wexford, ambitiously campaigned last season, hard to fancy

runners.name: Thisistheway
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over hurdles; career highlight a win in Red Mills Auction Final at the 2025 Punchestown festival last year; has run creditably in good handicaps; staying on when falling three out at the Punchestown festival; outpaced from the last when fourth behind Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown; 5lb wrong, good claimer.
runners.comment: Outpaced from the last when fourth behind Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown, 5lb wrong

runners.name: Putapoundinthejar
runners.spotlight: Fair fifth in a valuable handicap hurdle at the Punchestown festival; a shade disappointing at Listowel in June before making amends at Bellewstown; may continue on the upgrade for Tony Martin who has won this race four times in the past 12 years.
runners.comment: Bellewstown winner, may continue on the upgrade, trainer has a fine record in this race

runners.name: Starting Fifteen
runners.spotlight: Promise in bumpers without winning; highly tried after winning a maiden hurdle at Limerick last Christmas; seventh in a 12-runner Grade 1 at the DRF, fifth of six in a similar race at Aintree.
runners.comment: Highly tried after maiden hurdle win at Limerick last Christmas, young horse, may improve

runners.name: Helvic Dream
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a career highlight when winning the Group 1 Tattersalls Gold Cup in 2021; very nearly matched that achievement when first-past-the-post in this race last year, demoted for causing interference to Ndaawi; no sign of that standard of form in valuable handicap over hurdles or on the Flat since then; still 5lb higher than 12 months ago.
runners.comment: Demoted for causing interference to Ndaawi here last year, no sign of similar form since
runners.owner: Mrs Caroline Hendron & Mrs M Cahill

runners.name: Laafi
runners.spotlight: Useful three-time Flat winner for William Haggas; has developed into a smart handicap hurdler; stuck to his task when first past the post in a big field at Aintree's Grand National meeting (2m, good to soft) only to be disqualified for a whip offence; 6lb extra for that arguably made the difference when he was beaten a neck in the Swinton at Haydock; progressive sort.
runners.comment: Stripped of Aintree win for whip misuse, beaten a neck in the Swinton, progressive sort

runners.name: Puturhandstogether
runners.spotlight: Won 4yo handicap hurdle at 2025 Cheltenham Festival and had a massive payday in last season's Irish Cesarewitch; down the field in three big handicap hurdles between late November and April; not much luck when unplaced favourite for the Chester Cup; flopped when well-fancied for the Ascot Stakes; questions to answer but could not be ruled out.
runners.comment: Fred Winter and Irish Cesarewitch winner, out of sorts this year but unwise to rule out

runners.name: Kai Lung
runners.spotlight: Won on the Flat in France (soft); looked promising when winning a 4yo maiden hurdle at Naas in January (2m, heavy); major doubts raised by his last four runs; pulled up in the Triumph; beaten when unseating at Fairyhouse; dropped away in Punchestown Grade 1; disappointing at Ballinrobe; beaten 8l in the big Flat handicap here on Tuesday; 5lb wrong.
runners.comment: Beaten 8l in the big Flat handicap here on Tuesday, 5lb out of the handicap

runners.name: Tounsivator
runners.spotlight: Did well to win a conditions event on the Flat at Fairyhouse this month on his first 2026 outing; fair fifth in Monday's big amateur race (one place in front of stablemate Too Bossy For Us); first hurdles run since fourth in this last year; could go well if recovered from Monday's race.
runners.comment: First hurdles run since fourth in this last year, fair fifth in Monday's big amateur race

runners.name: Earls
runners.spotlight: Durable handicapper with 11 wins to his name, the latest being on his favoured soft ground at Roscommon last September; has notched three consecutive seconds since May; concerning that he has been unplaced in seven Galway attempts.
runners.comment: Winner of 11 races, three seconds in a row since May, unplaced in seven Galway attempts

runners.name: Calm The Jets
runners.spotlight: Won a Dundalk maiden on debut in January 2025; weak turf form after long absence; has slumped in the ratings; perhaps worth a market check.
runners.comment: AW maiden winner on debut, weak turf form after long absence, has slumped in the ratings

runners.name: Molto Amichi
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on five occasions; had become expensive to follow before beating Earls narrowly at Killarney, justifying good market support; has gone up 8lb, but his confidence may have been boosted by the breakthrough win.
runners.comment: Runner-up on five occasions, beat Earls narrowly at Killarney to lose his maiden tag

runners.name: No More Porter
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been gained at the Curragh and a large portion of his places too; good second over 1m at his favoured venue last month; has continued in good form with placed efforts at Killarney and Gowran.
runners.comment: Best known as a three-time Curragh winner, recent placed form at Killarney and Gowran

runners.name: Pink Oxalis
runners.spotlight: Four wins last year; fourth in this race last year; career best when winning a competitive fillies' handicap at Leopardstown in September; uneven form this season; most recent run, when second in a six-runner contest at the Curragh, gives her a fighting chance.
runners.comment: Fourth in this race last year, 3lb higher now, most recent run gives her a fighting chance

runners.name: Hygge
runners.spotlight: High draw is a concern; however, holds a strong chance based on Killarney maiden win in May and an emphatic recent hurdles success at Cork; form of Killarney win has been shown in a good light by runner-up Treasure Rose in winning twice and finishing fifth in a Listed race.
runners.comment: High draw is a concern, strong chance based on Killarney maiden win and recent hurdles win

runners.name: Glyndwr
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner for Ger Lyons; in good form last October/November; has been a high price on all four starts for this stable; should enter calculations now after showing a revival of form in two Leopardstown races.
runners.comment: Three-time AW winner for Ger Lyons, has shown a revival of form in two Leopardstown races

runners.name: Zaraahmando
runners.spotlight: Placed in three consecutive 1m handicaps lately; closely matched with No More Porter on Gowran running five days ago; missed an engagement on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Placed in three consecutive 1m handicaps lately, missed an engagement on Tuesday

runners.name: Java Wood
runners.spotlight: Narrowly denied at Gowran in June only two days after Limerick win; well beaten in the race in which San Aer finished second here on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Narrowly denied at Gowran two days after Limerick win, well beaten in the here on Tuesday

runners.name: Cala Bonita
runners.spotlight: AW and turf winner; 12lb higher than for her turf win; a staying-on seventh in the 8.15 on Tuesday; held by San Aer on that running.
runners.comment: AW and turf winner, 12lb higher than for her turf win, 7th in the 8.15 on Tuesday

runners.name: Merlin The Wizard
runners.spotlight: Three wins in Britain in 2023 at up to 1m; regressive in 2024 and 2025 seasons; produced best run for some time at Dundalk in March when good second over 1m; after three more runs, took advantage of a drop in grade when winning a claimer at Limerick; backed that up in a Ballinrobe handicap; was 4lb wrong when ninth in the big handicap here on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Has found a new lease of life, was 4lb wrong when 9th in the big handicap here on Tuesday

runners.name: Tolebi
runners.spotlight: 7f winner for Andre Fabre, has dropped to a more reasonable mark after four Irish starts; talented apprentice booked, but stable's other runner, Glyndwr, is more appealing.
runners.comment: 7f winner for Andre Fabre, has dropped to a more reasonable mark after four Irish starts

runners.name: Exquisite Acclaim
runners.spotlight: Nine wins in all, but only one on turf from 32 starts; fair third over 7f at Fairyhouse on his penultimate start; last of six on most recent outing.
runners.comment: Nine wins in all, but only one on turf from 33 starts, last of six on most recent start
runners.owner: Thomas J O'Connor & Ms Hazel McGuinness

runners.name: Jujubella
runners.spotlight: UK-trained; three of her four wins in UK have come on AW up to this trip; has dropped in the weights in the last year and solid runs in defeat lately; needs a bit more.
runners.comment: Has dropped in the weights in the last year; solid runs in defeat lately; needs a bit more

runners.name: Showyoutheropes
runners.spotlight: Winner in UK over 1m2f and best run for this yard came over that trip at Dundalk; not as good over 1m4f at Tramore but can be sharper for that run and do better; non-runner in the 8.15 here on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Not at best over 1m4f at Tramore but can do better with that run behind him

runners.name: Blackjack Hills
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; dual winner was just denied over 1m2f at Leopardstown last time and has a shout if as effective over this trip
runners.comment: Just denied over 1m2f at Leopardstown last time; shout if as good over this trip; reserve

runners.name: Annie's Angel
runners.spotlight: Broke her maiden over 1m as a 2yo here in heavy ground but no win since; tried over hurdles recently without success but some decent efforts; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Won a 2yo maiden here; no win since but some good efforts incl' over hurdles; a squeak
runners.owner: Conor O'Connor & Colum Currie & Mark Devenny

runners.name: Faro Island
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m3f at Down Royal last year and 9.5f at Gowran last month; not bad runs twice since but needs more off this mark.
runners.comment: Won over 9.5f at Gowran last month; not bad runs twice since but needs more off this mark

runners.name: Oust
runners.spotlight: Maiden had been consistent enough in defeat until a poor run as fav' at Tramore last time so has to rebound with a tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Poor run as fav' at Tramore last time so has to rebound with a tongue-tie added

runners.name: Baila Conmigo
runners.spotlight: Won his third race on AW when scoring over this trip last time; 5lb higher and needs to do more to break his turf duck.
runners.comment: Won his third race on AW last time; 5lb higher and needs to do more to break his turf duck

runners.name: Nancee Spain
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; wide margin winner on soft at Roscommon last year but not as good twice this term and blinkers added; could do with more rain
runners.comment: Not at best twice this term and blinkers added; could do with more rain; reserve

runners.name: Berto Ramirez
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles at Down Royal in May but was poor in soft ground last time; Flat maiden ran well enough in defeat here as a 2yo and has a shout on his best form.
runners.comment: Hurdle winner is a maiden on Flat but has a shout on his best form; has run well here
runners.owner: D O'Mahony & D McHugh & D J Kelly & G Butler

runners.name: Autumn Twist
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose sort has been soundly beaten on recent Flat runs but ran a cracker over hurdles at Bellewstown last time; chance if converting that back to this sphere.
runners.comment: Runner-up over hurdles at Bellewstown last time; chance if converting that back to Flat

runners.name: Justenzia
runners.spotlight: Third runner for yard; runner-up at Gowran (9.5f) and Ballinrobe (1m5f) early in the season but her last three runs have been well below that level so needs a return to best.
runners.comment: Her last three runs have been well below that level so needs a return to best

runners.name: Rodeo Blues
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark over 9.5f at Ballinrobe and followed up over 1m3f at Naas when she wandered late on; is up 9lb for that but is improving rapidly and is on the shortlist from a low draw.
runners.comment: Won her last two; up 9lb but is improving rapidly and is on the shortlist from a low draw
runners.owner: Annus Mirabilis Synd'/Sean O'Driscoll/Middle Cow Unlimited

runners.name: Arch Enemy
runners.spotlight: Ground-versatile sort has hit form lately, winning over 1m2f at Navan and carrying a 7lb penalty at Killarney over just short of this trip; up another 4lb but has run well in defeat at this track and looks a player.
runners.comment: Won at Navan and Killarney lately; up 4lb but has run well in defeat here;  looks a player

runners.name: Speckled Meadow
runners.spotlight: Course winner over 7f in 2022 has run well in defeat back here since over 1m; similar efforts last three runs including up to an extended 1m3f; needs more; tough draw.
runners.comment: Similar efforts last three runs including up to an extended 1m3f; needs more; tough draw

runners.name: Western Bandit
runners.spotlight: Has shown some ability in maidens over various trips without progressing; raised in trip for handicap debut and not without a chance.
runners.comment: Some ability in maidens; raised in trip for handicap debut and not without a chance

runners.name: Quiz Test
runners.spotlight: First reserve; a record of 1-23 but is consistent enough and has run well in defeat over C&D; tough draw but not ruled out if getting in.
runners.comment: Has run well in defeat over C&D; tough draw but not ruled out if getting in; reserve

runners.name: Day Trader
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose winner has been soundly beaten on his last two Flat starts but has a chance on his Dundalk sixth last December.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten his last two Flat runs but has a chance on his Dundalk sixth last December

runners.name: Lily Parr
runners.spotlight: Maiden has shown some ability in defeat but has to improve hugely from her poor return at Roscommon when beaten 24l.
runners.comment: Has to improve hugely from her poor return at Roscommon when beaten 24l

runners.name: Rhythm King
runners.spotlight: One of his five wins came over 7f at this track in 2024; lost his form at the end of last year, and this trip is new; encouraging display when sixth of 17 (Dark Summit, eighth) over a shorter trip here on Tuesday.
runners.comment: Won over 7f here in 2024; lost his form at the end of last year and this trip is new

runners.name: Flashy Fred
runners.spotlight: Third on sole point run and posted similar efforts in defeat in bumpers at Downpatrick and Killarney; should be involved again but needs to find more to score.
runners.comment: Similar efforts in bumpers at Downpatrick and Killarney; needs to find more to score

runners.name: Martymill
runners.spotlight: His two best runs came on debut at Fairyhouse last November and at Listowel (2m4f) last time; the cheekpieces worn then are retained and this 2f drop in trip should be fine; chance.
runners.comment: Returned to form at Listowel (2m4f) last time; the cheekpieces worn then retained; chance

runners.name: Sir Vinny
runners.spotlight: Similar efforts in defeat in two bumpers, at Punchestown and Bellewstown; got wound up before the start last time and that is a concern here; shouldn't be far away if running his race.
