runners.comment: Similar efforts in defeat at Punchestown and Bellewstown; shouldn't be far away again

runners.name: Burning Like Fire
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; beaten 20l on sole point start but the winner looks smart and went on to make 290,000GBP at the sales; the market may be a guide to expectations.
runners.comment: Beaten 20l on sole point start but the winner looks smart; the market may be a guide

runners.name: Colliers Quay
runners.spotlight: Finished in the frame in three of five point starts; will have to do a fair bit more on bumper debut.
runners.comment: In the frame in three of five points; will have to do a fair bit more on bumper debut

runners.name: Rond Point
runners.spotlight: Ran a cracker when just denied on second point start back in May; bought by current connections for 80,000GBP after; leading amateur retains the ride and is one to consider, especially if market strength behind him.
runners.comment: Just denied on second point run; one to consider, especially if market strength behind him

runners.name: Run Ted Run
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to winners Kilbarry Chianti (2m3f hurdle), Kilbarry Lilly (2m4f hurdle) and Kilbarry Classic (bumper); dam unraced half-sister to winners incl' Tropical Lady (1m2f Group 2); from a fine family but made only E4,000 as a foal then realised E45,000  as a 3yo; maximum respect from this source.
runners.comment: From a fine family; realised E45,000 as a 3yo; commands maximum respect from this source

runners.name: Market Square
runners.spotlight: Comes from a decent pedigree; ran with credit on debut at Punchestown behind an impressive winner; the hood worn then is retained and should be more closely involved with improvement to come.
runners.comment: Ran with credit on debut at Punchestown; can be more closely involved with improvement

runners.name: Dieux Diligence
runners.spotlight: Ran a solid race on debut at Punchestown when just behind Sir Vinnie and Monday's bumper runner-up here Which Flannerys (stablemate); ran green then so can go close if more switched on now.
runners.comment: Ran a solid race on debut at Punchestown; ran green then so go close if more switched on

runners.name: Gruncle
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; half-brother to winners Blakey Boy (2m4f-3m2f hurdle/chase) and Knocknagoran Lady (2m6f/3m1f hurdle); dam from the family of Grand National winner Rule The World; E2,000 vendor buyback as a 3yo; seems one to just watch on debut.
runners.comment: A E2,000 vendor buyback as a 3yo; seems one to just watch on debut

runners.name: Girl From The West
runners.spotlight: Beaten 25l on debut at Cork last month and will have to improve loads from that.
runners.comment: Beaten 25l on debut at Cork last month and will have to improve loads from that

runners.name: Colga Boys
runners.spotlight: Tailed-off on recent debut at Ballinrobe and can't be fancied on that evidence.
runners.comment: Tailed-off on recent debut at Ballinrobe and can't be fancied on that evidence

runners.name: Macdonagh Park
runners.spotlight: One of two runners for yard; well-bred sort was runner-up on his third point start and ran respectably on bumper debut at Punchestown; tongue-tie added and has to improve a fair bit.
runners.comment: Ran respectably on bumper debut at Punchestown; tongue-tie on; has to improve a fair bit

runners.name: Gusserane
runners.spotlight: Pulled-up in both point starts but some promise on bumper debut at Listowel; will have to improve plenty from that.
runners.comment: PU in both points but some promise on bumper debut at Listowel; has to improve plenty

runners.name: Mister O Reilly
runners.spotlight: Little promise in points, a hurdle and this bumper last year so is passed over today.
runners.comment: Little promise in points, a hurdle and this bumper last year so is passed over today

runners.name: Monard Flyer
runners.spotlight: Beaten 38l on debut at Ballinrobe and will have to improve loads on that for a local trainer.
runners.comment: Beaten 38l on debut at Ballinrobe and will have to improve loads on that; local trainer

races.race_name: European Breeders Fund EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Roots In Touche
runners.spotlight: Disappointing fourth at Catterick (5f, good to firm) last month but prior to that she was a promising second at 28-1 in the Hilary Needler at Beverley (5f, good to firm) on debut, and she sets a good standard if rediscovering that form.
runners.comment: Disappointing at Catterick but sets good standard if rediscovering her Beverley debut form

runners.name: Funky Dory
runners.spotlight: 48,000euros yearling; first foal; dam 5f debut winner (RPR 94), sister to 5f 2yo winner Desert Jungle, half-sister to winners Devonshire (1m Group 2) and Hurryupharriet (5f 2yo Listed), out of multiple 5f winner; represents powerful 2yo yard; this Dandy Man newcomer could have a big part to play.
runners.comment: Dam 5f debut winner (RPR 94); powerful 2yo yard; could have big part to play on debut
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Ltd Xlvii & E Burke

runners.name: Great Blasket
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner whose best effort this year came when a close-up third over C&D in May, taking his form figures at this track to 213; below his best in two starts since and has left the Newland-Insole stable (bought for 9,000gns); visor replaces blinkers for his yard debut and he's interesting.
runners.comment: C&D form figures read 213; interesting in a first-time visor on his stable debut

runners.name: Tardaff
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two novice/maiden events last year but she's failed to beat a rival home in each of her last three starts, including two handicaps this year; lots to prove.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival home in each of her last three starts and has lots to prove

runners.name: Degale
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 13 starts came in a Ripon novice over 1m in 2024; best effort this term came when third of 11 over this C&D in May but he's been down the field on his last three starts; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Best effort this term came over C&D in May; down the field in recent starts; tongue-tie on

runners.name: Theme Park
runners.spotlight: Often slowly away, just as he was when winning at Doncaster (1m, good to firm; first-time tongue-tie) last week having dropped a long way in the weights; has to be respected under a 5lb penalty.
runners.comment: Often slowly away; won in a first-time tongue-tie at Doncaster last week; 5lb penalty

runners.name: Relevant Range
runners.spotlight: Gained his second win on turf when landing a Doncaster handicap under Elle-May Croot 12 days ago, bouncing back from a lesser effort; can't be dismissed off this 4lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Doubled his tally on turf when winning at Doncaster latest; not dismissed off 4lb higher

races.race_name: Download The Oddschecker App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Supplicate
runners.spotlight: Improved on her debut form when winning at Lingfield (1m, AW) in December and she took another major step forward when making all to beat a subsequent winner at Bath (1m2f, good to firm) in May; returns after another break but that was a comfortable success last time and she's open to more progress on handicap debut; big player.
runners.comment: Made it 2-3 when making all at Bath in May; big player again on handicap debut

runners.name: Sassicaia
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) in December but he's been well held in three subsequent runs including two handicaps (1m2f, good to firm); still early days but he needs to raise his game to make an impact.
runners.comment: Won on Wolverhampton debut in December but he's been well held in three subsequent runs

runners.name: Bee Farmer
runners.spotlight: Mixed form in three novice/maiden events but he started his handicap career with a rallying fourth at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago; looks interesting now upped to this trip and he's a half-brother to some useful winners.
runners.comment: Promising fourth on handicap debut at Yarmouth and he looks interesting upped to this trip

runners.name: Crown Office
runners.spotlight: Won a Leicester maiden (6f, soft) last October but he was gelded after a disappointing comeback at Newbury in April; ran into some trouble when a respectable fourth at Sandown in June but he failed to build on that at Ascot (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago; still unexposed after only six starts but he needs improvement at this new trip.
runners.comment: Unexposed gelding but he needs improvement on this step up to 1m2f

runners.name: Affection
runners.spotlight: Won four times on the Flat when based in France, with first three on AW and latest on good to soft; hasn't been with David Pipe for long but she was well held at Salisbury (1m2f, soft) last month and it was the same story on her hurdling debut at Newton Abbot (second of three) last time; others preferred.
runners.comment: Four Flat wins in France but well held under both codes in two runs for current yard

races.race_name: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands B, C & D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Marquessofanglesey
runners.spotlight: Progressive form in his first three runs culminating in a near-miss in a Wolverhampton maiden (8.6f, AW) last month; flopped on handicap debut at Ffos Las (1m2f; last of five) but may have had stamina issues and he sets a good standard on this drop back in trip; key player back in a novice.
runners.comment: Sets a good standard on his best form and he had an excuse over 1m2f latest; key player
runners.owner: Julie Martin & David R Martin & Partner

runners.name: Queen's Hame
runners.spotlight: Gleneagles filly who is out of an unraced half-sister to 1m4f Group 2 winner Pongee; well-held second when odds-on for Ripon debut (1m, good) this month but she ran well for a long and was 8l clear of the third; should improve for that experience and she's respected.
runners.comment: Held when odds-on at Ripon but she ran well for a long way and was 8l clear of the third

runners.name: Salvezza
runners.spotlight: 36,000euros 2yo; fifth foal; half-brother to winners Sayulita (German 1m2f), Idalita (French 1m5f/14.5f) and Cefalu (US 8.5f turf); dam French 1m winner, half-sister to winners Salve Venezia (German 1m2f Listed) and Sun Of Gold (French 1m6f Listed); yard is in good form and he needs watching in market on debut.
runners.comment: 36,000euros 2yo; has good pedigree and he needs watching in market on debut

runners.name: Matter Of Britain
runners.spotlight: Victor Ludorum gelding; beaten 6l when runner-up at Hamilton (8.3f, good to firm) two weeks ago but that was behind a 2-13 shot and he pulled clear of the third; should know more this time and has possibilities if he can build on that debut effort.
runners.comment: Chased home a useful rival on recent Hamilton debut and he's in the mix

runners.name: Time Alone
runners.spotlight: Weak 14-1 shot and he finished a remote sixth of nine on recent Wolverhampton debut (7f, AW).
runners.comment: Weak 14-1 shot and he finished a remote sixth of nine on recent Wolverhampton debut (7f)

runners.name: Sixty Plus
runners.spotlight: Reeled off four straight hurdle wins last summer before losing his way; minor form when qualifying for a mark on the Flat since but he's proved well ahead of it since handicapping with cheekpieces refitted, winning by 6l at Thirsk (1m4f) and Lingfield (1m6f; both good to firm); 3lb well in under big penalty; major claims.
runners.comment: Four hurdle wins; major improvement for Flat handicaps, winning at 1m4f/1m6f; 3lb well in

runners.name: Beggarman
runners.spotlight: Turf wins at 1m6f (good to soft) and 2m (good); quite well treated now and his AW reappearance was encouraging but he didn't fare so well back on turf in June and it's two years since he was risked on good to firm ground.
runners.comment: Quite well treated; well held back on turf latest; hasn't run on good to firm since 2024
runners.owner: Mrs E Bickerton And A Streeter

runners.name: Best Night
runners.spotlight: Had placed form at 1m4f and 1m7f in France; 2-13 over hurdles for this yard but she hasn't looked well treated since her March win and wasn't at her best three weeks ago; her Flat mark doesn't look anything special either.
runners.comment: Placed at 1m4f/1m7f in France; two hurdle wins in Britain but below best latest

runners.name: Simiyann
runners.spotlight: Well treated on the form of his two 2m wins (good to firm and good) in 2025 and although he hasn't been himself this year, the signs were better when he was second of five on this course (2m2f) two weeks ago; has another well-treated rival to contend with today but he should be competitive.
runners.comment: Well treated on 2025 winning form at 2m; best run of year last time; can be competitive

runners.name: Molly Mac
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden who was well held at Wolverhampton (7f) two weeks ago but she went close over 6f there on her penultimate run; has claims if she can recapture that form and she's in the mix back in trip.
runners.comment: 0-13 but she went close at Wolverhampton (6f) on penultimate run; in the mix back in trip

runners.name: Auspicious
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in his last two runs but he's a dual winner who bounced back when beating 13 rivals at Redcar (6f, good) in May; that form puts him in the picture and yard has won this race in last two years; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Tailed off in last two runs but he bounced back with a win at Redcar in May; not ruled out

runners.name: Saeculamation
runners.spotlight: Won off 4lb higher at Chelmsford (6f, AW) in December but he's not easy to predict and has finished down the field in his last three starts; record is now 1-18 and others are more convincing,
runners.comment: Sole win was on AW in December and he's not easy to predict; down the list

runners.name: Mereside Spark
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who has bled from the nose in her last three starts but she made some encouraging late headway when fourth at Redcar (6f, good) last month; continues to drop down the weights and has possibilities if she can find some extra spark.
runners.comment: Bled from the nose in her last three runs but has claims if she can find some extra spark

runners.name: Muddy Nora
runners.spotlight: Unexposed filly who found improvement when a front-running third in a Redcar handicap (6f, good) last month; finished ahead of Mereside Spark in that race and she's a big player if she can back that up.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly who found improvement when a front-running third at Redcar; big player

runners.name: Wagyu Star
runners.spotlight: Has had issues at the start in all three runs and she's been beaten 13l or more in all of them; now goes handicapping with blinkers added but she needs lots of improvement after another break.
runners.comment: Handicap newcomer but she needs lots of improvement back in trip; blinkers added

runners.name: Henriette Ronner
runners.spotlight: Won in first-time blinkers for William Haggas at Newcastle (6f) in January but she's not come close to that form in seven subsequent runs for two different yards; now 3lb lower than for her win but overall record is 1-13 and others are preferred; headgear removed.
runners.comment: Overall record of 1-13 and she's been well held in four runs for current yard; opposable

runners.name: Audere
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who has not finished closer than 6l to a winner including in three handicaps (5f-7f); mark has bottomed out now and she needs a transformation back on turf.
runners.comment: 0-6 and she's not finished closer than 6l to a winner; needs a transformation back on turf

races.race_name: oddschecker.com AJA Novice Amateur Jockeys' Handicap (Riders With 3 Wins Or Less At Start Of Season)

runners.name: Galaxy Wonder
runners.spotlight: Has form figures of 14323112253 since Boxing Day and that latest third was a good effort from a wide draw at Wolverhampton; still looks on a workable mark and he's respected in suitable conditions back on turf; yard also runs Palazzo Persico.
runners.comment: Has form figures of 14323112253 since Boxing Day and he's respected back on turf

runners.name: Palazzo Persico
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner for Ed Dunlop and he made it 2-3 for current yard when landing novice amateurs' race at Catterick (1m4f, good to firm) two weeks ago; up another 2lb but remains well treated on his old form, and four of his wins have come over this trip; leading contender.
runners.comment: Made it 2-3 for Tony Carroll when winning novice amateurs' race at Catterick; key player

runners.name: Showmedemoney
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner split between AW and turf; has mixed record since his last success in February but he was only just caught at Windsor (1m, good to firm) last time; has possibilities if he can back that up and he has won over this trip.
runners.comment: Back to form with a close call at Windsor and has claims if he can back that up

runners.name: Yafaarr
runners.spotlight: Turned things around with a win at Redcar (1m, good) last month and he's held his form with placed efforts in both runs since; hard to rule out another good run but he looks weighted near best off this mark and is untried at this trip.
runners.comment: In-form 4yo but he looks weighted near best off this mark and is untried at this trip

runners.name: Flightofthephoenix
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on his best form at up to 1m2f last season but he's still a maiden after 11 starts and has finished seventh in both runs this year; has bit to prove after another break and others are preferred.
runners.comment: 11-race maiden who has finished seventh in both runs this year; down the list
runners.owner: Old Gold Racing, Tim Cottier & Partner

runners.name: Poet's Dawn
runners.spotlight: Admirable veteran who recorded his 15th turf win when battling well to score at Ripon (1m2f, good) 12 days ago; that was his third success from his last seven starts and he's a big player again off only 2lb higher here.
runners.comment: Recorded his 15th turf win when scoring at Ripon; big player again off only 2lb higher

runners.name: Bobacious
runners.spotlight: Placed off 3lb higher at Lingfield (1m2f, good) on seasonal/stable debut in May but not quite in same form on any of three subsequent outings, the last twice here (1m2f/8.5f); needs to up his game.
runners.comment: Placed on seasonal/stable debut but not quite in same form on his three runs since

runners.name: Golden Circet
runners.spotlight: Scored over 8.5f here (good) last summer and kept on for respectable fourth at Brighton (1m4f, good to firm) on latest Flat start in May; returns to this code on a workable mark and after a recent second over hurdles; likely contender.
runners.comment: Course winner; returns to the Flat after recent second over hurdles; likely contender
runners.owner: W Trenchard, A Coupland, Cheam Marketng

runners.name: Qitaal
runners.spotlight: Without a win since 2024 but earns good marks for his consistency in recent months and lost out only by a head off today's mark at Ripon (1m2f, good) in June; probably won't be far away.
runners.comment: Without a win since 2024 but has been consistent lately; probably won't be far away

runners.name: Magical Merlin
runners.spotlight: Managed only fifth of eight when upped to 1m2f at Windsor (good to firm) two months ago and remains without a win since 2023; continues to edge down the weights but needs to turn a corner.
runners.comment: Only fifth of eight when upped to this trip in June and remains without a win since 2023

runners.name: Show Biz Kid
runners.spotlight: Not far off career-best form when coming from the rear for clearcut success at Bath (1m2f, firm) in May but not seen to same effect on either subsequent outing; chance may depend upon others setting a strong pace.
runners.comment: Twice safely held since come-from-behind win in May; probably needs a good pace to aim at

runners.name: Oj Lifestyle
runners.spotlight: Best known as a Brighton specialist but also runs this track well; needs to rebound from disappointing C&D run four weeks ago but looked in good nick when scoring at Brighton (1m2f, good to firm) in June; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Disappointed over C&D last time but has good claims if judged on Brighton win in June

races.race_name: Spillers EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Benefacta
runners.spotlight: Showed fair form when placed at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) last month, his third start, and has plenty of scope for improvement over this longer trip but he's not straightforward and might still be a work in progress.
runners.comment: Placed over 6f at Nottingham last month but has some quirks and is not without risk

runners.name: Out Of This World
runners.spotlight: Raced too freely and was disappointing odds-on favourite when well-held fourth at Beverley (7.4f, good) last month but made winning debut over that C&D (good) in May and will have strong claims here if the first-time hood helps him to relax.
runners.comment: Below form after racing too freely last time but won in pretty good style on debut

runners.name: Aminaty
runners.spotlight: Posed no threat on her debut but was seemingly in process of faring better before stumble 2f out cost her momentum over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; remains tricky to weigh up but could have a say.
runners.comment: Unlucky not to finish closer than seventh over C&D this month, having stumbled 2f out

runners.name: Camarda Rc
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam twice-raced half-sister to winners Al Shemali (UAE 1m1f Group 1) and Tungsten Strike (2m Group 2), out of Listed-placed 1m2f winner; with a good stable and doesn't need to be anything special to get competitive on debut.
runners.comment: Out of half-sister to two Group winners; in good yard; doesn't need to be anything special

runners.name: Otis Bay
runners.spotlight: 32,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to winners Rajindri (7f; RPR 97) and Rhodreego (Italian 1m); dam unraced half-sister to 7f winners Marbaan (Group 2) and Convergence (Group 3); trainer has only occasional debut winners but this gelding still makes some appeal on paper.
runners.comment: Out of a well-connected dam and makes some appeal on paper

runners.name: Secret Flite
runners.spotlight: Never better than midfield when 50-1 for debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; probably one for further down the line.
runners.comment: Never better than midfield when 50-1 for debut at Newbury (6f) three weeks ago

runners.name: Banged Up
runners.spotlight: Out of a useful French 1m-10.5f winner; made low-key debut when 16th of 18 at Newbury (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Made low-key debut when 16th of 18 at Newbury (6f) three weeks ago

runners.name: Whiskey Galore
runners.spotlight: Well beaten over C&D (good) on debut at start of this month and didn't achieve much when last of five at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago.
runners.comment: Did not show enough on his first two starts (7f/6f) to warrant serious consideration

runners.name: Cool King
runners.spotlight: First foal from unraced sister to smart 7f/7.4f winner Bravais; made favourite for debut at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last month but was soundly beaten; presumably thought capable of much better.
runners.comment: Well held when favourite for debut but presumably thought capable of much better

runners.name: Imperial Cult
runners.spotlight: Battled well to win apprentice jockeys' race from the front at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) on Friday and is now 3-4 for George Baker; escapes a penalty here and will be fine over the longer trip; makes obvious appeal.
runners.comment: 3-4 for current stable and escapes penalty for Sandown win on Friday; makes obvious appeal

runners.name: Two Plus Two
runners.spotlight: Scored at Bath in May and was one of two to pull clear of the others when close second of four off today's mark at Nottingham (also 1m6f, good to firm) last month; didn't fire on latest outing but this drop back in trip won't be a problem if he's back on song.
runners.comment: Didn't fire last time but has won this season; a possible if back on song

runners.name: Stage Show
runners.spotlight: Held on gamely to cause 66-1 shock on Flat return at Salisbury (1m4f, good) in May but was safely held on both subsequent outings and is far too inconsistent to support with confidence; had recent wind op.
runners.comment: Gamely caused 66-1 shock in May but is far too inconsistent to rely upon

runners.name: Twilight Moon
runners.spotlight: Now only 1lb higher than when beginning this season with 1m4f AW win in April but looked out of sorts on last two outings; swapped usual cheekpieces for new visor last time; goes without any headgear today.
runners.comment: Began season with AW win in April but out of sorts lately

runners.name: Dream Harder
runners.spotlight: Signed off for Ian Williams with below-par AW run in the autumn and finished last on both turf starts for new stable this year; on good mark now but needs first-time tongue-tie to aid a return to form.
runners.comment: Finished last on first two starts for new stable this year; tongue-tie now added

runners.name: Trio
runners.spotlight: Bounced back quickly from a below-par AW run to win narrowly over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago and is now 2-9; recent 5lb rise demands more from her but she ought to give another good account.
runners.comment: Narrow C&D winner this month and now 2-9; recent 5lb rise demands more from her
runners.owner: M H Dixon & J L Rowsell

runners.name: Celestra
runners.spotlight: Did not need to improve to made all at skinny odds in Yarmouth maiden (first-time cheekpieces) last month, her fifth start, but finished well down the field on subsequent handicap debut at Ascot (also 1m, good to firm) and now has a point to prove.
runners.comment: Made all in Yarmouth maiden last month but subsequent handicap debut was disappointing

runners.name: Too Hot To Tango
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent filly who came good at 11th attempt, with win from off the pace at Windsor (1m, good to firm; second a next-time-out winner) last month; only 3lb higher here and likely to play another major role.
runners.comment: Consistent filly; raised only 3lb for breakthrough win at Windsor last month; big player

runners.name: Chantelle
runners.spotlight: Launched career with two 7f AW wins at Wolverhampton during the winter; absent since close second of four at Southwell (1m) in February but has scope for improvement in turf handicaps.
runners.comment: 2-3 on AW during the winter; open to improvement now switched to a turf handicap

runners.name: Credit Forgedd It
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden; finished in front of Eyes Front when second over C&D two weeks ago but that seemed unlikely for the vast majority of the race; the placings may be reversed this time.
runners.comment: Stayed on late for 2nd over C&D 2 weeks ago; not sure to confirm placings with Eyes Front

runners.name: Koffee And Kale
runners.spotlight: Won a 5f novice at Leicester as a 2yo; the handicapper has been firmly in command this year, with headgear making no difference on his last two starts; steps up to 7f and drops into Class 6 company but others are more appealing.
runners.comment: Handicapper on top in 2026; down in class and up in trip but others are more appealing

runners.name: Red Moon
runners.spotlight: Improved for the switch to handicaps when winning a five-runner race at Salisbury (7f, good) last month; no progress twice since and connections now reach for cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Salisbury win on handicap debut but no progress since; now tried in headgear

runners.name: Real Gold
runners.spotlight: 0-11 but she was running well on AW earlier in the year; well-beaten last of three at Lingfield on her return to action a fortnight ago; needs to leave that well behind.
runners.comment: Promise on AW but her turf efforts leave her with more to prove

runners.name: Eyes Front
runners.spotlight: 0-11 but he has shown winning potential and he wasn't beaten far over C&D two weeks ago; another bold bid expected.
runners.comment: 0-11 but he has shown winning potential; good C&D fourth latest; one to take seriously

runners.name: Imagine That
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far into fourth at Chepstow last month, her first run over 7f; dropped 2lb and there should be more to come from her.
runners.comment: Fair fourth upped to 7f at Chepstow last month; still has low mileage

runners.name: Sun Of Dolly
runners.spotlight: Ran as well as he ever has when fifth over C&D two weeks ago; that was just his sixth start so he could have more to offer but he does have work to do with Credit Forgedd It and Eyes Front.
runners.comment: 5th, finishing behind two of today's opponents, over C&D two weeks ago; still low mileage

runners.name: Elvetham
runners.spotlight: Won two 6f handicaps on AW in the spring; he has held his form on turf this summer and another big run looks likely; more appealing than most.
runners.comment: Two AW wins in spring and he's run well in defeat on turf since; in the mix once again

runners.name: Harry Brown
runners.spotlight: Better known for his AW exploits but he has been in good order on turf this summer; closely matched with Twirler on latest C&D run.
runners.comment: Running well on turf this summer; closely matched with Twirler on latest C&D run
runners.owner: Peter Crate And Gallagher Bloodstock Ltd

runners.name: Victor Cee
runners.spotlight: Hamilton win for Karl Burke 12 months ago; dropping down the weights for current stable and his latest third at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm) was respectable; change of headgear today.
runners.comment: Handicapper in command so far this year; change of headgear not enough to tempt

runners.name: Lady Gormire
runners.spotlight: Three solid efforts for Michael Dods this season, chasing home a progressive rival at Catterick (7f, good to firm) on her handicap debut three weeks ago; should give it a good go from the front.
runners.comment: Second behind a thriving rival on her handicap debut at Catterick latest; can do better

runners.name: Twirler
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; creditable fourth in a stronger C&D handicap three weeks ago; dropped 1lb and likely to give it another good go.
runners.comment: C&D winner; creditable 4th in a Class 4 here latest (6f); should give her running again

runners.name: Sugar Sugar
runners.spotlight: She has shown promise in three maiden runs but also a tendency to hang markedly left; makes her handicap debut at a realistic level but how she will take to this track remains to be seen.
runners.comment: Has hung left in all three starts; makes handicap debut at a realistic level; carries risk

runners.name: Mount Mogan
runners.spotlight: His last five wins have come on AW at Lingfield (7f), the latest when last seen in February; vulnerable under today's conditions after five months off.
runners.comment: 7f AW win when last seen in February; vulnerable under today's conditions

races.race_name: Book To Stay- Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap

runners.name: My Mate Mackley
runners.spotlight: Has continued to run well (including in cheekpieces) since dead-heating on handicap debut at Chepstow (5f, good to soft) in May, including when staying on to be beaten just over a length behind Havin A Flyer at Southwell (5f, Tapeta) seven days ago; 6lb better off so has a good chance of being able to reverse the form.
runners.comment: Beaten just over a length by Havin A Flyer at Southwell seven days ago; now 6lb better off

runners.name: Sands Of Seve
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D (first-time visor) for Robert Cowell in March; beaten a short head on stable debut at Musselburgh (5f, good) last month, but failed to beat a rival at Ayr (5f, good to firm; blindfold removed late) ten days ago; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: C&D winner in March, but needs to bounce back from a lesser effort last time

runners.name: A Lott Of Kane
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt here (6f) in March; not disgraced when fourth of ten over C&D last month but disappointed when sent off favourite at Leicester (5f, good) a week later; has undergone wind surgery since; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Won over 6f here in March; has undergone wind surgery since disappointing last time

runners.name: Havin A Flyer
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 21st attempt when making all to beat My Mate Mackley by just over a length at Southwell (5f, Tapeta) a week ago; 6lb worse off with the runner-up under penalty, but not dismissed now that she has got her head in front.
runners.comment: Made all to beat My Mate Mackley at Southwell a week ago; 6lb worse off but not dismissed

runners.name: Runamara
runners.spotlight: 0-10 in handicaps since winning a Bath maiden (5.7f, soft) last September; second of ten at Kempton (6f, Polytrack) in April, but has gone quiet again on turf since; cheekpieces need to make a difference.
runners.comment: 0-10 in handicaps since winning a Bath maiden; cheekpieces need to make a difference

runners.name: Princess Of Limnos
runners.spotlight: Poor form in three starts including when beaten a long way into third of four on stable debut at Bath (5.7, firm) in May; possible she could improve now switched to a handicap, but it will very much be needed.
runners.comment: Poor form in three starts; could improve on handicap debut but it will very much be needed

runners.name: Viennetta
runners.spotlight: Hooded all starts; well held in two outings for Jamie Osborne last August and again on stable debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month; half-sister to an AW winner, but needs plenty of improvement on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Well beaten in all three starts; needs plenty of improvement on handicap/AW debut

runners.name: Tommie's Angel
runners.spotlight: Not shown a great deal in three starts over 6f/7f on Tapeta/turf; needs the switch to a handicap and drop in trip to bring about improvement; stable looks to hold better prospects with Havin A Flyer.
runners.comment: Not shown a great deal in three starts; drops in trip on handicap debut

runners.name: R P McMurphy
runners.spotlight: Has failed to beat a rival in his last two starts here, the latest on his return from 144 days off this month; however, he was in fine form on the AW in midwinter prior to those below-par efforts,  winning twice over C&D; may be worth chancing and market support would be interesting.
runners.comment: Below par last two starts but a good spell in midwinter included two wins over C&D

runners.name: Between Me And U
runners.spotlight: Made a successful stable debut over C&D in September 2024 and, having dropped 1lb lower than for that win, was scoring for the first time since when just getting up at Kempton (1m, Polytrack) this month; back up 3lb but respected nonetheless.
runners.comment: C&D winner; 3lb higher than when winning at Kempton last time; respected

runners.name: Pearly Squirrel
runners.spotlight: Course regular who won over 7f in March; only 2lb higher and mainly running well in the meantime but, although she has run with credit over this far, there's a suspicion that a shorter trip suits her better.
runners.comment: Course winner; has run well over this far, but shorter trips may suit her better

runners.name: The Dark Baron
runners.spotlight: Two of his three wins have come here (9.5f/7f), the latest in March; ran with credit when fourth of ten at Lingfield (7f, Polytrack) last time and he makes the shortlist.
runners.comment: Two of his three wins have come here and he makes the shortlist

runners.name: Volto Di Medusa
runners.spotlight: Twice well beaten off this mark since winning narrowly at Lingfield (1m, Polytrack) last month; can blow the start; blinkers return, but risky.
runners.comment: Twice well beaten since winning at Lingfield last month; can blow the start; risky

runners.name: Cy Twombly
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in three outings for the Crisfords as a 2yo, but little in five starts for this yard since returning from a long absence in December; switch to a visor will need to make a big difference.
runners.comment: Shown little in five starts for this yard since returning in December; visor on

runners.name: Onslow Gardens
runners.spotlight: Placed in both previous goes over C&D but is now 0-21; needs something extra starting out for another new yard (same owners).
runners.comment: 0-21; needs something extra starting out for another new yard
runners.owner: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya

runners.name: Portman Blue
runners.spotlight: 0-7; not beaten far into sixth of 13 at Southwell (7f, Tapeta) a week ago and drops in grade; still has something to prove back up in trip.
runners.comment: 0-7; has something to prove back up in trip

runners.name: King Chaos
runners.spotlight: Ended a lengthy losing run at Newcastle (1m4f, Tapeta) in January but disappointed when favourite back there (1m2f) later in month; no headgear on this return from 191 days off and this trip looks on the sharp side.
runners.comment: Won over 1m4f at Newcastle in January, but disappointed there later in month; off 191 days

runners.name: Bun Bang Fai
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in seven starts for Archie Watson last year; changed hands for 4,000gns in October and now makes her debut for new yard after ten months off; watch the market.
runners.comment: 0-7; makes her stable debut after ten months off; watch market

runners.name: Cephalus
runners.spotlight: 11-time AW winner, the latest a Newcastle seller for the Moores (1m, Tapeta) last October; regressive for this yard in the meantime despite plummeting in the weights; best watched unless the market suggests otherwise.
runners.comment: Has proved regressive for this yard despite plummeting in the weights; best watched

runners.name: Chimes Of Thunder
runners.spotlight: Made a promising return/stable debut when beaten a neck at Haydock (1m, good to firm) in April, but hasn't really built on it in two outings since; still respected on this switch to the AW if resuming her progress.
runners.comment: Hasn't built on a promising reappearance, but still respected on AW debut

runners.name: Bintward
runners.spotlight: 780,000euros yearling; half-sister to 1m4f winner Caspi Star (RPR 95); dam 9.7f/1m2f winner (including Listed; 105), half-sister to useful 12.5f winner Tashi, out of 5f winning half-sister to useful 1m-1m2f winner Al Galayel; plenty to like on breeding and the market should be revealing.
runners.comment: Plenty to like on breeding and the market should be revealing

runners.name: Pyramid
runners.spotlight: Brother to winners Samburu (7f/8.5f including 2yo/US; RPR 105), Fingerpaint (Group-placed 7f; 100) and Settlement (7f AW; 83); dam 7f 2yo winner (89), sister to US 8.5f Grade 2 winner Set Piece, half-sister to 6f/6.5f Listed winner Alocasia; any market support on debut would be significant.
runners.comment: Nicely bred and any market support on debut for top yard would be significant

runners.name: Indian Mary
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros yearling; sister to three winners including Indian Wish (1m/9.4f including AW/Listed; RPR 111) and Ashana (German 10.5f Listed; 98), half-sister to five winners including Incampo (French 6.7f-1m4f including 2yo; 103); dam 5.5f-7f winner (including German Listed; 100); attractive pedigree and sire 5-17 (29%) here in the past five seasons but the stable only has the occasional winner first time out; market useful.
runners.comment: Attractive pedigree but the stable only has the occasional winner first time out

runners.name: Wyvill
runners.spotlight: Sent off 150-1 when a well-beaten sixth of seven on last month's Leicester debut (1m, good); may be one for handicaps in due course.
runners.comment: Well beaten on last month's Leicester debut; may be one for handicaps in due course

runners.name: Walking On Stars
runners.spotlight: Dam German 1m3f winner (Group 3; RPR 106), sent off 18-1 when an eyecatching fifth of 12 on her Southwell debut (7f, Tapeta) a week ago; bred to relish the longer trip and any improvement from that first outing would put her right in the mix.
runners.comment: Eyecatching fifth of 12 on her Southwell debut a week ago; bred to relish the longer trip
runners.owner: Gestuet Schlenderhan Gmbh U Co Kg

runners.name: Dor's Dazzler
runners.spotlight: Showed a little ability on the AW at the start of the year but it would be surprising if she proved good enough in this field after 166 days off; hood given a go.
runners.comment: Surprising if she proved good enough in this field after 166 days off; hood on

runners.name: Golden Caviar
runners.spotlight: 160,000gns yearling; has been off since finishing a well-held fifth of seven on his Newmarket debut (1m, good; 40-1) last October; may not come into his own until handicapping.
runners.comment: Well held on Newmarket debut last October; may not come into his own until handicapping

races.race_name: Free Bets On attheraces.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C & D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Angel Sense
runners.spotlight: Close up in 6f novices at Kempton (Polytrack) and Nottingham on first two starts, but subsequent appearances here (7f) and at Newbury (6f; tongue tied) were well below that form; player if back on song for stable which also runs a leading contender in Supreme Star.
runners.comment: Close up in 6f novices on first two starts but well below form in both runs since

runners.name: Supreme Star
runners.spotlight: Ran twice at Nottingham (6f, good to firm) this summer, when racing freely on debut but much improved (leading 4f) for second of five to a red-hot favourite 13 days ago; stable runs two; bold show is likely from stall 1.
runners.comment: Much improved, leading 4f, for second of five to a red-hot favourite at Nottingham (6f)

runners.name: Ouragan
runners.spotlight: Modest form over C&D on debut and much better when front-running second of ten in novice at Newbury (6f, good to firm; well backed) three weeks ago; drawn wide but still looks a serious contender.
runners.comment: Front-running second of ten in novice at Newbury (6f; well backed) three weeks ago

runners.name: Location Location
runners.spotlight: First-time hood when a close second at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) on latest start; eyeshield is now added; place chance again but needs further improvement if he's to win.
runners.comment: Hooded when a close second at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) on latest start; eyeshield now

runners.name: Conscientious
runners.spotlight: By Due Diligence; second foal; brother to 6f/7f 2yo winner Glitterati (RPR 91); unraced dam out of maiden half-sister to useful winners Audience (7f/1m) and Pacific Pride (5f/6f); gelded newcomer for whom the market should guide, with yard also running Ouragan.
runners.comment: By Due Diligence; gelded newcomer and his yard also runs Ouragan

runners.name: Huda's Joy
runners.spotlight: 25,000gns yearling by Sergei Prokofiev; third foal; half-sister to 6f winner Cuban Lady (RPR 83); dam 7f 2yo/1m winner (90) out of Listed-placed 1m 2yo winner; yard is 1-18 with 2yos this season.
runners.comment: 25,000gns yearling by Sergei Prokofiev; yard is 1-18 with 2yos this season

runners.name: God Of Titans
runners.spotlight: 100-1, weakened to go down by 23l in a novice at Newbury (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; steps down in class.
runners.comment: 100-1, weakened to go down by 23l in novice at Newbury (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago

runners.name: Montgomery Bell
runners.spotlight: By Land Force; first foal; dam placed at 1m6f-2m AW (RPR 65), out of French 1m5f winning half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Librisa Breeze; stable's first 2yo runner this season was due at Goodwood 5.20.
runners.comment: By Land Force; first foal; dam placed at 1m6f-2m AW (RPR 65)

runners.name: Postremo
runners.spotlight: 33-1, came from the rear when just over 5l sixth of ten in maiden at Bath (5f, good) in early May; should improve but needs to in a major way.
runners.comment: 33-1, came from the rear when sixth of ten at Bath (5f, good) in early May; should improve

runners.name: Trust In Far
runners.spotlight: Low-level form at big odds in all four starts, including a seller.
runners.comment: Low-level form at big odds in all four starts, including a seller

runners.name: Hunky Dory
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in April and only a length behind Hockney last time at Kempton when conceding 8lb to that rival; has a bad draw but still has to be considered at these weights.
runners.comment: Has a bad draw but still has to be considered on these favourable terms

runners.name: Jungle Drums
runners.spotlight: Can be hard to predict but he's a five-time winner after his narrow C&D success here recently (led late on); every chance at these weights with something similar.
runners.comment: Recent C&D handicap winner; every chance at these weights with something similar
runners.owner: Jim And Claire Ltd And Jon & Kay Collins

runners.name: Mission Command
runners.spotlight: A bit to prove in the reapplied visor and back over 6f, with his last win coming at 7f; badly drawn last time at Chester but disappointed the run before as well.
runners.comment: Badly drawn last time at Chester but disappointed the run before as well

runners.name: Manly Fireball
runners.spotlight: Made all for clearcut success in C&D novice last month but only fifth to Jungle Drums next time and he's not weighted to reverse those placings.
runners.comment: Behind Jungle Drums last time and not weighted to reverse those placings

runners.name: Seu Jo
runners.spotlight: 1m AW win in France in March; downgraded into a claimer after three heavy defeats in handicaps for this yard (6f-1m).
runners.comment: Downgraded into a claimer after three heavy defeats in handicaps for this yard (6f-1m)

runners.name: Buzz Box
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner at Newcastle (5f-6f); fair debut effort for this yard but then finished last at Southwell on his return from a break.
runners.comment: Fair debut for this yard but then finished last at Southwell on his return from a break

runners.name: Hockney
runners.spotlight: Three wins at 6f, two on Polytrack; inconsistent and not well drawn for a front-runner.
runners.comment: Three wins at 6f, two on Polytrack; inconsistent and not well drawn for a front-runner

runners.name: Havanagreattime
runners.spotlight: Has gained his wins over 6f on turf and 7f on AW; inconsistent since last success but has a chance on these figures now into a claimer if in form after his break (yard debut); drawn wide.
runners.comment: Has a chance on these figures now into a claimer if in form after his break

runners.name: Hakin Adraar
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden having his first run at anything shorter than 7f and blinkers are tried; one of the lowest rated in the field.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden having his first run at anything shorter than 7f and blinkers are tried

runners.name: Trust Sergei
runners.spotlight: Probably failed to stay 7f last time and won a C&D handicap the time before; however, he's got a lot on his plate at these weights.
runners.comment: In form but he's got a lot on his plate at these weights

runners.name: Punchbowl Flyer
runners.spotlight: Unfavourably treated on these terms but he's in form after back-to-back handicap wins at 6f; should give his running.
runners.comment: Unfavourably treated on these terms but he's in form after back-to-back handicap wins

races.race_name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap

runners.name: Worlington
runners.spotlight: In cheekpieces/tongue-tie for the first time when a nose winner at Ffos Las and his run the following week at Lingfield was too bad to be true (completely tailed off); has a chance on that winning form, being only 3lb higher.
runners.comment: Baffling last run but he won the time before over this far off just 3lb lower

runners.name: Sir Griflet
runners.spotlight: His close fourth over C&D three runs back gives him similar claims to Goldfinder; soft ground a feasible excuse next time and he was out of the weights last week at Ascot; in this weaker company he's entitled to run well.
runners.comment: Good run here in early June and feasible excuses for subsequent defeats

runners.name: Si White
runners.spotlight: Uncompetitive at about 1m but stepped up to 1m3f for last week's handicap debut at Southwell (1m3f AW) and was on top when it mattered despite not looking entirely straightforward; it could be that he's learning on the job; penalised.
runners.comment: Successful handicap debut last week (1m3f) despite showing quirks; penalised
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Xxx & Chris Rees

runners.name: Crown Inn To Win
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in April off 5lb lower (in this first-time headgear combination) and wasn't far away next time at Haydock, since when he's had a wind operation; every chance if the break doesn't hold him back.
runners.comment: Career-best form when last seen and since had a wind op; respected

runners.name: Evening Fades
runners.spotlight: Best of her four runs was on debut over 1m on the AW; beaten double-digit lengths in her subsequent races and was easy to back at 7-1 on handicap debut 19 days ago; bred to be better than this but reservations for now.
runners.comment: Bred to be better than this but reservations for now; beaten 10l on handicap debut

runners.name: Goldfinder
runners.spotlight: Didn't look straightforward as he ran in snatches before finishing well for a near miss over C&D two months ago; still lightly raced so he might yet iron out those quirks.
runners.comment: He ran in snatches before finishing well for a near miss over C&D two months ago

runners.name: Forever Perfect
runners.spotlight: Beat Crown Inn To Win over C&D in April and was second to that horse on her return visit, after which she was again runner-up back here; Thirsk was disappointing but could bounce back from that.
runners.comment: Thirsk was disappointing but her form here is hard to fault; considered

runners.name: Blue Tulip
runners.spotlight: Heavy defeats to begin with and only sixth of ten when 22-1 for handicap debut here at this trip; has to step up.
runners.comment: Only sixth of ten when 22-1 for handicap debut here at this trip; has to step up

runners.name: Rajbello
runners.spotlight: Low-key form for Richard Hughes, including four handicaps; changed hands for 6,000gns.
runners.comment: Low-key form for Richard Hughes, including four handicaps; changed hands for 6,000gns

runners.name: La Kosmos
runners.spotlight: Qualifying runs at 7f; didn't improve for stepping up to 9.4f on her handicap debut here when 20-1; plenty to prove, though there are 1m4f winners in the family.
runners.comment: Tries a new trip with plenty to prove, though there are 1m4f winners in the family

runners.name: Baron Wagstaff
runners.spotlight: Gelded ahead of his handicap debut at Nottingham (1m2f) but went off 33-1 and trailed in last.
runners.comment: Gelded ahead of his handicap debut (1m2f) but went off 33-1 and trailed in last.

runners.name: African Gib
runners.spotlight: Not close to troubling the judge in his four races, last time always out the back on handicap debut at Windsor (1m2f; 10-1); in good hands but hard to be confident about him right now.
runners.comment: Last time he was always out the back on handicap debut at Windsor (1m2f; 10-1)

races.race_name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Based
runners.spotlight: Off the mark when winning over C&D last month, but he wasn't helped by a slow start and racing wide on the home turn when a 5l third here nine days ago; stable is in form and he could be worth another chance.
runners.comment: C&D winner last month but didn't have things work out here last time; worth another chance

runners.name: Emery Down
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f maiden on the AW last May for her previous yard; has dropped a fair way in the weights since handicapping and ran well when runner-up in a 0-75 at Ayr (7f, good; ridden more prominently than usual) last time; makes the shortlist down in grade.
runners.comment: Ran well when runner-up in a 0-75 at Ayr last time; makes the shortlist down in grade

runners.name: Cooramook
runners.spotlight: 20-race maiden but she's finished runner-up over C&D on her last two outings, including when chasing home a subsequent winner 16 days ago; no obvious reason why she can't go well.
runners.comment: 0-20 but runner-up over C&D on her last two starts; bumped into a subsequent winner latest

runners.name: African Spirit
runners.spotlight: Mostly struggled since winning on his debut in 2023 but he posted a solid effort when third of 11 at Windsor (1m, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces/tongue-tie) last month; needs to back that up now dropped back in trip.
runners.comment: Winless since his debut in 2023 but it was a solid effort in first-time headgear latest

runners.name: Faster Bee
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner; doubled his tally over this C&D when winning in first-time cheekpieces in April but he's struggled in both starts since; others look stronger.
runners.comment: Gained his second C&D win here in April but struggled in both starts since

runners.name: White Umbrella
runners.spotlight: Four-time course winner (6f/7f), with the most recent coming last June off a 7lb higher mark; solid effort here over 6f nine days ago and steps back up in trip with place claims.
runners.comment: 7lb lower than for her most recent course win; solid effort here over 6f nine days ago

runners.name: Beaming Light
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been over 1m; went close here over 8.5f in February and kept on into fourth (behind Cooramook) after missing the break over C&D last time; will need things to drop right given his hold-up style.
runners.comment: Three-time winner over 1m; kept on into fourth over C&D last time (behind Cooramook)

runners.name: Megaphone
runners.spotlight: Two solid efforts in April over 6f when the hood was applied, but he's failed to beat a rival over this trip on his last two starts and is still unproven on this far; has been absent for 70 days and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival on last two starts and is unproven over this trip; off for 70 days

runners.name: Havanita
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who was beaten 16l when last of seven in a first-time visor (retained) at Chepstow (7f, good) 45 days ago; best watched.
runners.comment: 0-8 and beaten 16l in a first-time visor at Chepstow last time; best watched
runners.owner: Mrs R Lyon & P R Chamings

runners.name: Iconic Times
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been over 6f at Kempton when trained by Heather Main; yet to build on his debut for this yard but is now down to a career-low mark; steps back up in trip and cheekpieces return (worn once previously).
runners.comment: Both wins over 6f at Kempton; yet to build on his stable debut for this yard

runners.name: Velvet Skies
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner in Ireland (7f/6f; AW/turf); 0-5 for Stephen Hanlon this year and he was well held at Hamilton (8.5f) 76 days ago; off since and now starts out for another new stable.
runners.comment: Three-time winner in Ireland; 0-5 for Stephen Hanlon this year; makes his yard debut

runners.name: Dashing Donkey
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner who is 4-13 on turf and 0-10 on the AW; gave it a good go from the front when fourth at Lingfield (7f, AW) 56 days ago but likely won't have things his own way here.
runners.comment: Four-time winner on turf; gave it a good go from the front when fourth at Lingfield latest

races.race_name: Download The Raceday Ready App Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Oh So Perfect
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who has been in good form since joining this stable, winning twice at Chelmsford and finishing in the first three on three occasions, most recently when runner-up at Musical Solider over C&D nine days ago; that was her first start since March and she has strong claims.
runners.comment: Has been in good form since joining this stable; second to Musical Solider here last time

runners.name: Captain Pickles
runners.spotlight: Well held on turf at Carlisle last time (first start for 54 days) but all three of his wins have been on the AW, two over 8.6f at this track; the return to this surface is a positive and he could go well.
runners.comment: Well held on turf last time but all three wins have been on the AW; could go well

runners.name: Musical Soldier
runners.spotlight: Made all over C&D in May and doubled his tally when winning here in first-time cheekpieces (tongue-tie back on today) under Jack Callan nine days ago; 1lb wrong under a 6lb penalty but has to be respected (C&D form figures read 121).
runners.comment: Carries a 6lb penalty for his recent win here; C&D form figures read 121; respected

runners.name: On Key
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 24th attempt when keeping on to beat Midnight's Dream over C&D two starts ago; didn't see things out under a penalty at Chepstow six days ago but he's now 3lb lower; solid.
runners.comment: Off the mark when winning over C&D two starts ago; 3lb wrong when third at Chepstow latest

runners.name: Yoko
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden; beaten 2l when second of four at Ffos Las (6f, good) last summer on her final start for David Evans; held on her stable debut at Chester (7f) last time but that was her first start for 346 days and she may take a step forward now down in grade; hood applied for her AW debut.
runners.comment: Held on her yard debut but that was her first start for 346 days; drops in grade; hood on

runners.name: The Spotlight Kid
runners.spotlight: Both AW wins have been on the AW at Kempton in November 2024 (7f/1m); creditable third of 13 at Lingfield (7.5f, good) in May and now switches back to the AW having been off since; place chance.
runners.comment: Both AW wins at Kempton in 2024; creditable run at Lingfield in May but has been off since

runners.name: Manton Road
runners.spotlight: Two course wins include one over C&D; has been placed in each of his last three starts, most recently when getting caught late after hanging left at Lingfield (1m) 17 days ago; drops in trip with cheekpieces on for the first time and he's shortlisted.
runners.comment: Dual course winner; placed in each of his last three starts; cheekpieces are now applied

runners.name: Mythical Isle
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when winning a C&D classified event last month and looked unfortunate not to finish closer when seventh in a handicap here over 8.6f 24 days ago; makes appeal.
runners.comment: Won a C&D classified event last month and unfortunate not to finish closer here last time

runners.name: Reputation
runners.spotlight: 13yo who reappeared with a win at Southwell in May before a good third over this C&D next time; however, he was well beaten at the former track last time and needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: 13yo who won at Southwell in May; needs to bounce back from a poor run there last time

runners.name: South Kensington
runners.spotlight: Ran well here over 8.6f in May and went one better at Southwell (7f, AW) next time, winning by a head; shaped as if still in good form here 59 days ago and has since undergone wind surgery (tongue-tie removed); usually held up so she needs things to fall right but is considered.
runners.comment: Won at Southwell in May; has had wind surgery since finishing fifth here 59 days ago

runners.name: Midnight's Dream
runners.spotlight: Dual winner last year (7f/1m; AW/good to firm) when trained by Roger Varian; has dropped in the weights and his last two efforts have been good, including when runner-up to On Key over this C&D two weeks ago, despite a wide trip; considered.
runners.comment: Has dropped in the weights and his last two efforts have been good, including here latest
